facts.mentions.sub: Annabawa da manyan mutane masu suna a cikin Alqur'ani, tare da nassoshi inda suka bayyana. Ƙididdiga ayoyi ne na faruwar kalmomi daga rubutun Alqur'ani.

about.h1: Alqur'ani shiriyar Allah ce ga bil'adama, yana nuna hanya madaidaiciya ta rayuwa tare da imani, adalci, rahama, da hisabi.
about.lede: AskQuran yana taimaka wa mutane su kai ga shiriyar Kur'ani a sarari, kai tsaye, kuma tare da mahallin da ya dace - ba amsa da aka ƙirƙira ba, ko da yaushe rubutun tushe.
about.whyHead: Alqurani shiriya ce ga rayuwar dan adam
about.whyP1: Yana magana da zuciya, iyali, al'umma, kasuwanci, adalci, rahama, hisabi, da alakar mutum da Allah. Tana koya wa mutane yadda za su bauta wa, yadda za su bi da wasu, yadda za su kāre ’yancin iyaye, ma’aurata, ’ya’yansu, ’yan’uwa, marayu, matalauta, da marasa galihu—da kuma yadda za su yi rayuwa da gaskiya, haƙuri, mutunci, da hakki.
about.whyP2: Yana ba da ja-gora sarai a kan al’amura da yawa da mutane suke fuskanta a rayuwarsu ta yau da kullum: gado, aure, saki, dukiya, ciniki, bashi, sadaka, zalunci, gafara, tuba, da halin mutum. Yana ba da labarun annabawa da al'ummomin farko - ba kawai a matsayin tarihi ba, amma a matsayin darussa game da imani, girman kai, zalunci, lalata, ɗabi'a, da sakamakon zaɓin ɗan adam.
about.beliefLead: An gina AskQuran akan wannan imani:
about.beliefHi: ya kamata mutane su iya isa ga shiriyar Alqur'ani a sarari, kai tsaye, tare da mahallin da ya dace.
about.whatP1: Lokacin da wani ya yi tambaya mai alaƙa da rayuwa, AskQuran yana bincika bayanan Alƙur'ani da ke akwai kuma ya dawo da nassoshi na Kur'ani masu dacewa - tare da ayah ta Larabci ta asali, zaɓaɓɓen fassarar, mahallin ayah, da tafsiri a inda akwai.

parables.title: Misalai na Alqur'ani
parables.subtitle: Misalai da Allah ya bayar a cikin Alqur'ani don bayyana shiriya, imani, sadaka, gaskiya, karya, da halayen mutane.
parables.sourceNote: Ana nuna misalai daga ayoyin Alqur'ani tare da fassara da tafsirin da aka adana kawai. AskQuran baya samar da nasa bayanin.
commands.title: Umarni da Hani

character.title: Taswirar Halayen Da'a
character.subtitle: Halayen da Alqurani ke goya baya don nomawa da halayen da za a gujewa, an nuna su tare da nassoshi da tafsirin ayah.
character.sourceNote: Wannan shafi yana zana halayen halayen Alqur'ani. Ba ya haifar da shawara ko hukunci na ɗabi'a.
more.trust: Abubuwan da Alqur'ani ke goyan bayan tare da ambaton ayah kai tsaye aka nuna. Larabci da fassarorin ana nuna su a zahiri daga tushe - babu abin da aka samar.
facts.plants.title: 'Ya'yan itace, Bishiyoyi da Tsirrai a cikin Alqur'ani
facts.plants.sub: Nassosin Alqur'ani game da sunayen 'ya'yan itatuwa, bishiyoyi, da abincin shuka, wanda aka nuna kawai daga nassosin ayah kai tsaye.
facts.plants.sourceNote: An samar da wannan jeri daga matches na larabci kai tsaye a cikin rubutun Alqur'ani na gida na Tanzil. Ba ya ƙara da'awar botanical ko tushen tafsir.

facts.plant.datesN: Wasu nassoshi sun ambaci bishiyar dabino, da ‘ya’yanta, ko dabino a cikin lambuna.
facts.plant.olivesN: 24:35 ya ambaci itacen zaitun mai albarka a cikin misalin haske.
facts.plant.fruitGeneralN: Waɗannan nassoshi suna amfani da kalmomin 'ya'yan itace gabaɗaya maimakon takamaiman 'ya'yan itace mai suna.
facts.plant.datePalmTreeN: Wannan ya mamaye da dabino saboda Alqur'ani ya ambaci dabino a matsayin bishiya kuma a cikin 'ya'yan itace da gonaki.
facts.plant.talhN: Fassarorin sun bambanta; wasu suna mayar da ita a matsayin ayaba mai lankwasa, wasu kuma kamar itacen ƙirya ko itace mai kama da magarya mara ƙaya. Ba a tilastawa gano gano asalin halitta ɗaya ba.
facts.plant.khamtN: Sau da yawa ana fassara shi azaman 'ya'yan itace/ itace masu ɗaci. An kiyaye lakabin a hankali.
facts.plant.treeGenericN: Waɗannan nassoshi suna amfani da kalmomin bishiyar gabaɗaya ko takamaiman mahallin bishiyar Alqur'ani.
facts.plant.fumN: Fassarorin sun bambanta; galibi ana yin tafarnuwa, alkama, ko hatsi. Ana kiyaye lakabin a hankali azaman "Fum".
facts.plant.rayhanN: Sau da yawa ana fassara shi azaman basil, shuka mai ƙamshi, ko shuka mai kamshi. An kiyaye lakabin a hankali.

m.lib.title: Laburare
m.lib.sub: Tarin nassoshi da aka tsara, waɗanda suka dogara ga Quran. Kowane nassi yana loda ainihin Larabcinsa da fassara da aka adana daga tushe — babu wani abu da aka ƙirƙira a nan.
m.set.tafLangSub: Harshen tafsir · Turanci a matsayin madadin
m.set.topicsLayoutSub: Yadda batutuwan da aka shawarta ke bayyana a Bincike
m.onb.s1b: Rubuta kowane batu, jigo, ko tambaya. AskQuran yana dawo da ayoyin da suka dace — Larabci, fassara, da tafsir — waɗanda aka nakalto kai tsaye daga tushen da aka ƙididdige.
m.onb.s2b: Kowace amsa tana da nassi kuma ba a canza ta ba. Babu rubutun addini da AI ya rubuta, babu ra'ayoyi — Quran kawai, fassarori ingantattu, da tafsir mai nisba.
m.onb.s3b: Saita harsunan manhaja, fassara, da tafsir. Kana iya canza kowanne a cikin Saituna a kowane lokaci.
m.splash.tagline: Nemi Quran. Karanta tushen da aka yi wa nassi kawai.
m.about.lede: Hanya da ta dogara ga tushe don bincika Quran: nassoshi, fassara, da tafsir — an gabatar da su ba tare da canji ba.
m.about.p0t: Tabbatacce daga tushe, ba a taɓa ƙirƙira ba
m.about.p0b: Kowane sakamako yana gabatar da ainihin Larabcin Quran (Tanzil), fassarorin da aka adana, da tafsir da aka adana kawai. Manhajar ba ta taɓa rubuta bayanin addini ba kuma ba ta canza rubutun tushe ba.
m.about.p1b: Bincike yana haɗa ayoyin da suka dace cikin tabbaci daga ƙididdiga — kana karɓar abubuwan tushe da aka yi wa nassi, ba amsa da aka rubuta ba.
m.about.p2b: Ana nuna tafsir daidai yadda aka adana shi kuma ba a taɓa fassara shi da na'ura ko musanya shi a shiru tsakanin harsuna ba.
m.about.p3b: Kowace ayah tana ɗauke da tushenta — Larabci, fassara, da (lokacin da aka nuna) nisbar tafsir — domin a iya gano komai zuwa asalinsa.
m.about.footer: Binciken Quran wanda aka tabbatar da shi daga tushe · nassoshi, fassara da tafsir
m.foot.builtBy: Dilawar Abbas ne ya gina shi tare da tallafin Ghazala Zafar a matsayin Sadaqah Jariyah.
m.foot.free: AskQuran kyauta ne, babu tallace-tallace, kuma koyaushe haka zai kasance. Ba ya neman gudummawa. Amsoshinsa sun dogara ne kawai a kan Quran, fassarori ingantattu, da tafsir, ba tare da wani rubutun addini da aka ƙirƙira ba.
m.foot.dua: Allah ya karɓi wannan ƙoƙarin, ya sa ya zama mai amfani, kuma ya gafarta duk wani kuskure.
m.foot.src: Rubutun tushe daga Tanzil · Fassarori da tafsir an gabatar da su ba tare da canji ba tare da cikakken nisba

repent.title: Tuba
repent.subtitle: Nassosin Alkur'ani game da tuba - rahamar Allah, sharuddan tawbah, da karbar tuba daga annabawa.
repent.sourceNote: Ana nuna nassoshin tuba daga ayoyin Alqur'ani kai tsaye kawai. Babu nasihar addini da aka samar.
repent.i.doNotDespair.title: Kada Ka yanke Kauna daga Rahama
repent.i.doNotDespair.label: Alkur'ani ya umarci muminai da kada su yanke kauna daga rahamar Allah.
repent.i.alwaysForgives.title: Allah Ya Gafarta Masa
repent.i.alwaysForgives.label: Alkur'ani ya ce Allah yana gafarta dukkan zunubai kuma yana karbar tuba na gaskiya.
repent.i.rahmahVast.title: Rahamar Allah mai girma
repent.i.rahmahVast.label: Allah ya wajabta rahama ga kansa, kuma rahamarSa ta yalwaci dukkan komai.
repent.i.genuineTawbah.title: Tuba ta Gaskiya
repent.i.genuineTawbah.label: Alqur'ani ya siffanta tawbah na gaskiya da komawa ga Allah da gaske.
repent.i.beforeDeath.title: Tuba Kafin Mutuwa
repent.i.beforeDeath.label: Alkur'ani ya ce ana karbar tuba kafin mutuwa ta yi kururuwa da kuma kafin alamun bayyanar.
repent.i.changeConduct.title: Canje-canje a cikin Hali
repent.i.changeConduct.label: Alkur'ani ya danganta tuba da barin zunubi da aikata ayyuka na qwarai.
repent.i.ibrahimSought.title: Ibrahim ya nemi gafara
repent.i.ibrahimSought.label: Addu'o'in Alqur'ani na Ibrahim yana neman gafarar kansa da iyayensa.
repent.i.adamHawwa.title: Adamu da Hawwa suka tuba
repent.i.adamHawwa.label: Adamu da Hawwa sun yarda da kuskurensu kuma Allah ya karbi tubarsu.
repent.i.yunus.title: Sai Yunusa Ya Amsa
repent.i.yunus.label: Yunus ya kira a cikin duhu Allah ya amsa ya cece shi.
repent.i.gateOpen.title: Bude kofar Gafara
repent.i.gateOpen.label: Al-Qur'ani ya tabbatar da cewa duk wanda ya tuba kuma ya gyara zai sami Allah Mai gafara.
repent.i.replaceWithGood.title: An Maye gurbin Zunubai da Ayyuka Nagari
repent.i.replaceWithGood.label: Alkur'ani ya yi alkawarin cewa Allah ya musanya zunubai da ayyukan alheri ga wadanda suka tuba na gaskiya.
repent.i.dontDelay.title: Kada Ku Jinkirta Tuba
repent.i.dontDelay.label: Alqur'ani ya kwadaitar da tuba a yanzu, kafin ayoyin Sa'a su zo.
nifaq.title: Munafunci
nifaq.subtitle: Nassosin Alkur'ani game da munafunci - alamomi, halaye, ƙaddara, da gargaɗi game da munafukai.
nifaq.sourceNote: Ana nuna nassoshi na munafunci daga ayoyin Alqur'ani kai tsaye kawai. Babu bayanin da aka samar.
nifaq.i.signsHypocrite.title: Alamomin Munafiki
nifaq.i.signsHypocrite.label: Alkur'ani ya siffanta wadanda suka ce sun yi imani amma ba su yi ba.
nifaq.i.lyingOaths.title: Amfani da Rantsuwa azaman Rufe
nifaq.i.lyingOaths.label: Munafukai suna ɗaukar rantsuwarsu a matsayin garkuwa kuma suna yin karya a cikin rantsuwarsu.
nifaq.i.mockBelievers.title: Muminai masu izgili
nifaq.i.mockBelievers.label: Munafukai suna izgili ga muminai a ɓoye yayin da suke da'awar imani a cikin jama'a.
nifaq.i.avoidPrayer.title: Kasala a cikin Sallah
nifaq.i.avoidPrayer.label: Alkur'ani ya ce munafukai suna zuwa sallah a kasala sai a gani.
nifaq.i.spreadFear.title: Yada Tsoro da Jita-jita
nifaq.i.spreadFear.label: Munafukai suna yada faɗa a tsakanin muminai kuma suna ta da fitina.
nifaq.i.lowerMost.title: Mafi ƙasƙanci Matsayin Wutar Jahannama
nifaq.i.lowerMost.label: Alqur'ani yana sanya munafukai a cikin mafi ƙasƙancin wuta.
nifaq.i.hellfire.title: Wutar Jahannama ga Munafukai
nifaq.i.hellfire.label: Alkur'ani ya yi gargadin wuta ga munafukai, namiji da mace.
nifaq.i.noIntercession.title: Babu Ceto Zai Taimaka
nifaq.i.noIntercession.label: Ko da Annabi ya yi musu addu'a sau saba'in, Allah ba zai gafarta musu ba.
nifaq.i.bidNoGood.title: Hana Kyau, Bid Mugunta
nifaq.i.bidNoGood.label: Munafukai suna hani da alheri kuma suna umurni da abin da bai dace ba.
nifaq.i.turnAway.title: Juya Lokacin Kira
nifaq.i.turnAway.label: Munafukai suna bijire da girman kai idan aka kiraye su zuwa ga hukuncin Allah.
nifaq.i.doNotObey.title: Kada ka yi da'a ga munafukai
nifaq.i.doNotObey.label: Alkur'ani ya yi umarni da kada a bi munafukai da kafirai.
nifaq.i.testOfFaith.title: Jaraba Ta Bayyana Munafukai
nifaq.i.testOfFaith.label: Allah yana jarrabar muminai kuma yana bambanta masu gaskiya da munafukai.
doj.title: Ranar sakamako
doj.subtitle: Nassosin Alqur'ani a Ranar Alqiyama - Sa'a, Tara, lissafi, Ma'auni, da sakamako.
doj.sourceNote: Ana nuna nassoshi na ranar sakamako daga ayoyin Alqur'ani kai tsaye kawai. Babu bayanin da aka samar.
doj.i.hourUnknown.title: Ba a San Sa'a ba
doj.i.hourUnknown.label: Abin sani kawai, sanin lokacin da Sa'a ke tsayuwa ga Allah yake.
doj.i.signsHour.title: Alamomin Sa'a
doj.i.signsHour.label: Al-Qur'ani ya ambaci alamomin da zasu gabaci zuwan sa'a.
doj.i.earthShaken.title: Duniya Tana Girgizawa
doj.i.earthShaken.label: Alkur'ani ya yi bayanin girgizar kasa idan Sa'a ta tsayu.
doj.i.allGathered.title: Duk Za'a Taru
doj.i.allGathered.label: Alkur'ani ya bayyana cewa za a tara dukkan bil'adama a gaban Allah.
doj.i.nothingHidden.title: Babu Abinda Za'a Boye
doj.i.nothingHidden.label: Za a nuna wa kowane rai abin da ya aikata, ba abin da zai ɓoye.
doj.i.prophetsTestified.title: Annabawa Zasu Shaida
doj.i.prophetsTestified.label: Alkur'ani ya ce kowace al'umma za ta sami shaida kuma Annabi zai yi shaida.
doj.i.deedsPresented.title: Za'a Gabatar da Ayyuka
doj.i.deedsPresented.label: Za a nuna wa kowane mutum tarihin aikinsa cikakke.
doj.i.selfTestimony.title: Kai da Gabas Zasu Shaida
doj.i.selfTestimony.label: Alqur'ani ya ce mutane za su karanta nasu littafin kuma gaɓoɓinsu za su ba da shaida.
doj.i.theScales.title: Ma'aunin Ayyuka
doj.i.theScales.label: Za a auna ayyukan akan ma'auni - ayyuka masu nauyi suna kaiwa ga nasara, haske zuwa hasara.
doj.i.recordOfDeeds.title: Rikodin Ayyuka
doj.i.recordOfDeeds.label: Kowane mutum za a ba shi littafin aikinsa a hannun dama ko hagu.
doj.i.noWrongDone.title: Babu Zalunci a Ranar nan
doj.i.noWrongDone.label: Alkur'ani ya tabbatar da cewa ba za a zalunce wani rai da komai ba a ranar sakamako.
doj.i.paradiseReward.title: Aljannah ga salihai
doj.i.paradiseReward.label: Za'a kawo salihai Aljanna kuma a basu ladarsu.
doj.i.hellfireReward.title: Wuta ga azzalumai
doj.i.hellfireReward.label: Alkur'ani ya yi bayanin yadda ake kora kafirai zuwa wuta rukuni-rukuni.
paradise.title: 'Yan Aljannah
paradise.subtitle: Bayanin Alqur'ani dangane da halayen wadanda za su shiga Aljanna da bayanin abin da ke jiransu.
paradise.sourceNote: Ana nuna nassoshin Aljanna daga ayoyin Alqur'ani kai tsaye kawai. Babu bayanin da aka samar.
paradise.i.believersPious.title: Muminai da masu takawa
paradise.i.believersPious.label: Alqur'ani ya bayyana halayen wadanda za su shiga Aljanna.
paradise.i.fearAllah.title: Masu tsoron Allah
paradise.i.fearAllah.label: Alkur'ani ya yi alkawarin Aljanna ga wadanda suka ji tsoron Allah kuma suka yi takawa.
paradise.i.patient.title: Mai haƙuri
paradise.i.patient.label: Al-Qur'ani ya saka wa wadanda suka yi hakuri da matsayi mai girma a cikin Aljanna.
paradise.i.truthful.title: Mai Gaskiya
paradise.i.truthful.label: Alkur'ani ya ce masu gaskiya za su amfana da gaskiyarsu.
paradise.i.charitableGivers.title: Masu Sadaka
paradise.i.charitableGivers.label: Alkur'ani yana ba da lada ga wanda ya yi sadaka yana neman fuskar Allah.
paradise.i.establishedPrayer.title: Masu tsai da Sallah
paradise.i.establishedPrayer.label: Tsaida sallah da tsare sallah yana daga cikin ayyukan yan Aljannah.
paradise.i.forgiving.title: Masu Gafara
paradise.i.forgiving.label: Alkur'ani ya yabi masu kame fushi da yafewa wasu.
paradise.i.rivers.title: Koguna da Lambuna
paradise.i.rivers.label: Alkur'ani ya siffanta Aljanna a matsayin lambuna da koguna ke gudana daga karkashinsu.
paradise.i.seeingAllah.title: Ganin Allah
paradise.i.seeingAllah.label: Alkur'ani ya siffanta wasu fuskoki a matsayin masu annuri, suna kallon Ubangijinsu.
paradise.i.eightGates.title: Shiga Aljannah
paradise.i.eightGates.label: Alkur'ani ya siffanta salihai da ake kai su Aljanna tare da bude musu kofofinta.
paradise.i.withoutReckoning.title: Shiga Ba tare da Hisabi ba
paradise.i.withoutReckoning.label: Alqur'ani ya siffanta shiga Aljanna da samun lada ba tare da hisabi ba.
paradise.i.companions.title: Sahabbai a Aljannah
paradise.i.companions.label: Muminai za su kasance tare da annabawa, masu gaskiya, da tsarkaka a cikin Aljanna.
hell.title: Mutanen wuta
hell.subtitle: Nassosin Alqur’ani akan waxanda za su shiga wuta – halayensu, da ayyukansu, da bayanin wuta.
hell.sourceNote: Ana nuna nassoshin wuta daga ayoyin Alqur'ani kai tsaye kawai. Babu bayanin da aka samar.
hell.i.disbelievers.title: Kafirai
hell.i.disbelievers.label: Alkur'ani ya yi gargadin cewa an yi tattalin wuta ga wadanda suka kafirta.
hell.i.arrogant.title: Mai girman kai
hell.i.arrogant.label: Wadanda suka kafirta da ayoyin Allah, suna shiga Wuta.
hell.i.hypocrites.title: Munafukai
hell.i.hypocrites.label: Ana sanya munafukai a cikin mafi ƙasƙan matakin Wuta.
hell.i.ribaTakers.title: Masu Riba
hell.i.ribaTakers.label: Alkur'ani ya gargadi wadanda suka ci riba za su kasance abokan Wuta.
hell.i.orphanWaste.title: Cin Dukiyar Marayu
hell.i.orphanWaste.label: Cin dukiyar marayu bisa zalunci ana kwatanta cin wuta.
hell.i.noCharity.title: Wadanda Basu Ba
hell.i.noCharity.label: Alkur'ani ya siffanta wadanda ba su ciyar da matalauta da dukiyar da aka tara.
hell.i.mockers.title: Wadanda Suka Yi izgili
hell.i.mockers.label: Wadanda suka yi izgili ga muminai, za a yi musu izgili a kansu.
hell.i.hellFireDesc.title: Bayanin Wuta
hell.i.hellFireDesc.label: Qur'ani ya siffanta wuta da fatu masu kuna, da ruwan tafasasshen ruwa, da abinci mai daci.
hell.i.sevenGates.title: Kofofi Bakwai
hell.i.sevenGates.label: Alqur'ani ya bayyana cewa, wuta tana da kofofi bakwai, kowanne da rabon da aka ba shi.
hell.i.gradations.title: Matakan Hukunci
hell.i.gradations.label: Alqurani ya siffanta darajar azaba a cikin wuta.
hell.i.noEscape.title: Babu Gudu
hell.i.noEscape.label: Alqur'ani ya ce kafirai ba za su bar wuta ba.
hell.i.regret.title: Nadamar Rana
hell.i.regret.label: Alqur'ani ya siffanta nadamar wadanda suke a cikin Wuta, da nufin komawa.
marriage.title: Aure & Iyali
marriage.subtitle: Nassosin Alqur'ani akan aure, haqqoqin ma'aurata, saki, lokacin jira, da dokokin iyali.
marriage.sourceNote: Ana nuna nassoshin aure daga ayoyin Alqur'ani kai tsaye kawai. Aikace-aikacen doka yana buƙatar ƙwararrun guraben karatu.
marriage.i.marriageInstruction.title: Umarnin Aure
marriage.i.marriageInstruction.label: Shiriya ta Alqur'ani akan aure, da sharuddansa, da umarnin yin aure.
marriage.i.dowryMahr.title: Sadaki / Mahr
marriage.i.dowryMahr.label: Alqur'ani ya yi umarni da baiwa mata maharsunsu a matsayin kyauta na wajibi.
marriage.i.polygamy.title: Auren mace fiye da daya da Adalci
marriage.i.polygamy.label: Alqur'ani ya halatta mata har hudu da tsantsar adalci kuma ya lura da wahala wajen yin hakan.
marriage.i.spouseRelationship.title: Dangantakar Ma'aurata
marriage.i.spouseRelationship.label: Alkur'ani ya siffanta ma'aurata a matsayin tufafin juna da kuma alamar natsuwa.
marriage.i.husbandDuty.title: Aikin Miji
marriage.i.husbandDuty.label: Alqur'ani ya umurci maza da su ciyar da matansu bisa adalci.
marriage.i.womensRights.title: Hakkin Mata
marriage.i.womensRights.label: Alkur'ani ya tabbatar da cewa mata suna da hakki kwatankwacin abin da ke kansu.
marriage.i.talaaq.title: Saki (Talaaq)
marriage.i.talaaq.label: Dokokin Al-Qur'ani game da kisan aure - wanda za'a iya sokewa, sakewa da kyau, ko riƙe da kyau.
marriage.i.irrevocable.title: Mutuwar Saki Ba Za'a Cire Ba
marriage.i.irrevocable.label: Bayan saki uku matar ba ta halalta har sai ta auri wani.
marriage.i.khul.title: Rabuwar Mata (Khul)
marriage.i.khul.label: Alqur'ani ya halatta mace ta mayar da mahararta idan ba za su iya kiyaye iyakokin Allah ba.
marriage.i.reconciliation.title: sulhu
marriage.i.reconciliation.label: Alkur'ani ya kwadaitar da nada masu sasantawa domin sulhu tsakanin ma'aurata.
marriage.i.iddah.title: Lokacin Jira (Iddah)
marriage.i.iddah.label: Alqur'ani ya shar'anta lokacin jiran matan da aka saki da wadanda aka kashe.
marriage.i.iddahPregnant.title: Iddah ga Mata masu ciki
marriage.i.iddahPregnant.label: iddar mai ciki tana ƙarewa idan ta haihu.
marriage.i.forbiddenMarriage.title: Haramta Digiri na Aure
marriage.i.forbiddenMarriage.label: Alqur'ani ya lissafo sunayen dangin da aka hana mutum ya aura.
marriage.i.ila.title: Rantsuwa (Ila)
marriage.i.ila.label: Hukuncin Alqur'ani akan mutumin da ya rantse ba zai kusanci matarsa ​​ba.
marriage.i.zihar.title: Zihar
marriage.i.zihar.label: Hukuncin Alqur'ani akan zihari da kaffararsa.
parents.title: Iyaye & Yan Uwa
parents.subtitle: Nassosin Alqur'ani game da girmama iyaye, kyautatawa a lokacin tsufa, haqqoqin yara, da kiyaye zumunta.
parents.sourceNote: Ana nuna nassoshi iyaye da dangi daga ayoyin Alqur'ani kai tsaye kawai. Babu shawarwarin da aka samar.
parents.i.honorParents.title: Girmama Iyaye
parents.i.honorParents.label: Umarnin Al-Qur'ani na kyautatawa iyaye - wanda aka sanya shi daidai bayan bautar Allah.
parents.i.neverSayUff.title: Kada Ka Taba Cewa Iyaye Uff
parents.i.neverSayUff.label: Alqur'ani ya hana ko da cewa uff ga iyaye kuma ya yi umurni da magana da mutunci.
parents.i.oldAge.title: Kula a Tsofaffi
parents.i.oldAge.label: Alkur'ani ya yi umarni da kulawa ta musamman da addu'a ga iyaye idan sun tsufa.
parents.i.nonMuslimParents.title: Iyayen da ba Musulmi ba
parents.i.nonMuslimParents.label: Alkur'ani ya yi umarni da kyautatawa ga iyaye wadanda ba musulmi ba amma ba da'a a cikin shirka ba.
parents.i.doNotObeyShirk.title: Kada Ku Da'a ga Iyaye A Cikin Shirka
parents.i.doNotObeyShirk.label: Biyayya ga iyaye baya kai ga shirka da Allah.
parents.i.childrenRight.title: Hakkin Yara
parents.i.childrenRight.label: Alkur'ani ya hana kashe yara kuma ya yi umarni da a samar da su.
parents.i.doNotKillChildren.title: Kar Ka Kashe Yara
parents.i.doNotKillChildren.label: Alkur'ani ya hana kashe yara saboda tsoron talauci.
parents.i.orphanRights.title: Hakkin Marayu
parents.i.orphanRights.label: Alkur'ani ya yi umarni da baiwa marayu hakkokinsu da kiyaye dukiyoyinsu.
parents.i.doNotDevourOrphan.title: Kada Ku Cinye Dukiyar Marayu
parents.i.doNotDevourOrphan.label: Qur'ani ya yi gargadin cewa masu cin dukiyar maraya ba da hakki ba, suna cin wuta.
parents.i.guardOrphanProperty.title: Tsare Dukiyar Marayu
parents.i.guardOrphanProperty.label: Alqur'ani ya yi umarni da a yi jarrabawa sannan a mayar da dukiyar maraya idan sun balaga.
parents.i.orphanInRighteousness.title: Kula da Marayu Adalci ne
parents.i.orphanInRighteousness.label: Ciyar da marayu da girmama su yana daga mafi girman ayyuka na qwarai a cikin Alqur'ani.
parents.i.doNotHumiliateOrphan.title: Kada ka wulakanta Maraya
parents.i.doNotHumiliateOrphan.label: Qur'ani ya la'anci masu tunkude maraya ko wulakanta su.
parents.i.kinship.title: Dangantakar zumunta
parents.i.kinship.label: Kiyaye zumunta umarni ne da adalci na Alqur'ani.
parents.i.maintainTies.title: Kiyaye Dangantakar Iyali
parents.i.maintainTies.label: Alkur'ani ya yi umarni da shiga cikin abin da Allah ya yi umarni da a hada shi.
parents.i.cuttingKinship.title: An haramta Yanke Zumunci
parents.i.cuttingKinship.label: Alkur'ani ya la'anci wadanda suka yanke alakar da Allah ya yi umarni da a kiyaye.
inherit.title: Gado & Wasiyya
inherit.subtitle: Nassosin Alqur'ani game da rabon gado, ka'idoji, wasiyya da ka'idojin rabo.
inherit.sourceNote: Ana nuna nassoshin gado daga ayoyin Alqur'ani kai tsaye kawai. Aikace-aikacen doka yana buƙatar ƙwararrun guraben karatu.
inherit.i.childrenShare.title: Rabon Yara
inherit.i.childrenShare.label: Alqur'ani yana gyara rabon gadon yara.
inherit.i.spouseShare.title: Rabon Ma'aurata
inherit.i.spouseShare.label: Alqur'ani yana gyara rabon maza da mata a gado.
inherit.i.parentShare.title: Raba Iyaye
inherit.i.parentShare.label: Kowane iyaye yana karɓar kashi shida na dukiyar idan akwai yara.
inherit.i.halfShare.title: Rabin Raba
inherit.i.halfShare.label: Ana kayyade rabin rabo ga diya mace wadda ba ta da yaya ko kanwa.
inherit.i.sixthShare.title: Raba Na Shida
inherit.i.sixthShare.label: Ana sanya na shida ga uwa yayin da mamacin ya haifi 'ya'ya.
inherit.i.ruleAfterDebt.title: Bayan Bashi da Wasiyya
inherit.i.ruleAfterDebt.label: Alqur'ani ya ce ana raba rabon gado bayan bashi da wasiyya.
inherit.i.afterWill.title: Bayan Cika Wasiyya
inherit.i.afterWill.label: Kafaffen hannun jari yana aiki ne bayan cika wasiyyar mamaci da bashi.
inherit.i.writingWill.title: Rubutun Wasiyya
inherit.i.writingWill.label: Alkur'ani ya yi umarni da yin wasiyya ga iyaye da dangi na kusa.
inherit.i.fairDistrib.title: Rarraba Gaskiya
inherit.i.fairDistrib.label: Maza da mata suna da rabo daga abin da iyaye da dangi suka bari.
inherit.i.doNotConsume.title: Kada Ku Ci Zalunci
inherit.i.doNotConsume.label: Alkur'ani ya hana cin rabon magada bisa zalunci.
riba.title: Riba & Arziki
riba.subtitle: Nassosin Alqur'ani akan riba, ciniki na gaskiya, ma'aunin gaskiya, bashi, da kare dukiya.
riba.sourceNote: Riba da nassoshi na dukiya ana nuna su daga ayoyin Alqur'ani kai tsaye kawai. Ba a samar da ra'ayi na fikihu ba.
riba.i.ribaForbidden.title: Riba Haramun Ne
riba.i.ribaForbidden.label: Alqur'ani ya hana riba kuma ya bayyana cewa za'a lalata ta.
riba.i.tradeVsRiba.title: Ciniki Halal ne, Riba Ba
riba.i.tradeVsRiba.label: Alqur'ani yana cewa Allah ya halatta ciniki kuma ya haramta riba.
riba.i.warFromAllah.title: Yaki Daga Allah Da Masu Riba
riba.i.warFromAllah.label: Alkur'ani ya yi gargadin cewa dagewa kan riba yana nufin yaki daga Allah da Manzonsa.
riba.i.previousNations.title: Riba Ta La'anci Al'ummar Da Ta Gabata
riba.i.previousNations.label: Al-Qur'ani ya lura cewa cin riba an la'anci Ahlul Kitabi shima.
riba.i.fairTrade.title: Kasuwancin Gaskiya
riba.i.fairTrade.label: Alkur'ani ya yi umarni da kada a ci dukiya ba bisa ka'ida ba da ciniki tare da yardar juna.
riba.i.fulfillContracts.title: Cika Kwangiloli
riba.i.fulfillContracts.label: Alkur'ani ya yi umarni da cika dukkan kwangiloli da alkawuran.
riba.i.weightsHonest.title: Ma'auni na Gaskiya da Ma'auni
riba.i.weightsHonest.label: Alkur'ani ya yi umarni da a ba da cikakken mudu da kuma rashin ha'incin awo.
riba.i.writingDebt.title: Rubuta Bashi
riba.i.writingDebt.label: Alqur'ani yayi umarni da rubuta bashi a rubuce tare da shaidu.
riba.i.noHardship.title: Sauƙi ga Mai Bashi
riba.i.noHardship.label: Alkur'ani ya yi umarni da bayar da bashi a cikin wahala har sai sauki ya zo.
riba.i.rightToProperty.title: Haƙƙin Dukiya
riba.i.rightToProperty.label: Alkur'ani ya hana cin dukiyar wani ba bisa zalunci ba.
riba.i.noCorruption.title: Babu Cin Hanci A Duniya
riba.i.noCorruption.label: Alkur'ani ya hana yada fasadi a cikin kasa.
charity.title: Sadaka & Zakka
charity.subtitle: Nassosin Alqur'ani akan bada zakka, sadaqah, ciyarwa akan tafarkin Allah, da kare marayu.
charity.sourceNote: Ana nuna nassoshi na sadaka daga ayoyin Alqur'ani kai tsaye kawai. Babu nasihar addini da aka samar.
charity.i.zakatObligation.title: Wajibcin Zakka
charity.i.zakatObligation.label: Umarnin Al-Qur'ani na bada zakka tare da tsayar da sallah.
charity.i.zakatPurifies.title: Zakka tana tsarkakewa
charity.i.zakatPurifies.label: Alqurani ya bayyana cewa bada zakkah tana tsarkake mai bayarwa da tsarkakewa.
charity.i.zakatRecipients.title: Masu Karbar Zakka
charity.i.zakatRecipients.label: Al-Qur'ani ya lissafa nau'o'i takwas da suka cancanci karbar zakka.
charity.i.orphansRight.title: Hakkin Marayu Na Kulawa
charity.i.orphansRight.label: Umarnin Alqur'ani na kyautatawa marayu da ba su hakkinsu.
charity.i.doNotConsumeOrphan.title: Kada Ku Ci Dukiyar Marayu
charity.i.doNotConsumeOrphan.label: Alqur'ani mai girma ya haramta cin dukiyar marayu bisa zalunci.
charity.i.giveSadaqah.title: Bada Sadaqah
charity.i.giveSadaqah.label: Jagoran Al-Qur'ani da kwadaitarwa don bayar da sadaka na son rai.
charity.i.sadaqahMultiplied.title: Sadaqah ta yawaita
charity.i.sadaqahMultiplied.label: Alqur'ani ya kwatanta sadaka da hatsin da ke girma sau ɗari bakwai.
charity.i.secretCharity.title: Bayarwa a Sirri
charity.i.secretCharity.label: Alkur'ani ya yabi yin sadaka a asirce kuma ya ce tana kankare zunubai.
charity.i.spendInPath.title: Ku ciyar a tafarkin Allah
charity.i.spendInPath.label: Alkur'ani ya yi umurni da ciyarwa a tafarkin Allah, kuma ya yi gargadin a kan zullumi.
charity.i.spendBest.title: Ku ciyar daga Mafi kyau
charity.i.spendBest.label: Alqur'ani ya yi umarni da ciyar da mafi kyawun abin da mutum ya samu kuma yake so.
charity.i.noReminders.title: Babu Tunatarwa Bayan Bayarwa
charity.i.noReminders.label: Alkur'ani ya hana yin sadaka da tunatarwa da munanan kalmomi.
charity.i.wayfarerNeedy.title: Wayfarer da Mabukata
charity.i.wayfarerNeedy.label: Alqur'ani ya ambaci matafiyi, mabukata, da miskinai a matsayin wadanda suka cancanci taimako.
crime.title: Laifuka, Adalci & Taimako
crime.subtitle: Nassosin Alqur'ani akan tsarkin rayuwa, qisa, sata, zina, zalunci, da fasadi.
crime.sourceNote: Ana nuna nassoshi na laifuka da adalci daga ayoyin Alqur'ani kai tsaye kawai. Aikace-aikacen doka yana buƙatar ƙwararrun guraben karatu.
crime.i.noUnlawfulKilling.title: Babu Kisan Haram
crime.i.noUnlawfulKilling.label: Alqur'ani mai girma ya haramta kashe rai sai da hakki.
crime.i.sanctityHuman.title: Tsarkin Rayuwar Dan Adam
crime.i.sanctityHuman.label: Kashe mutum daya ba tare da dalili ba kamar kashe dukkan bil'adama ne.
crime.i.murder.title: Kisa Da Sakamakonsa
crime.i.murder.label: Alkur'ani ya yi gargadi game da yin hukunci mai tsanani kan kisa ba bisa ka'ida ba.
crime.i.qisasRule.title: Qisas - Daidaita Ramuwa
crime.i.qisasRule.label: Alqur'ani ya tsara ramuwar gayya daidai gwargwado don ɗaukar rai kuma ya kira ta da rai.
crime.i.pardonMercy.title: Afuwa da Kuɗin Jini
crime.i.pardonMercy.label: Alkur'ani ya bada izinin afuwa daga dangin wanda aka kashe da kudin jininsa.
crime.i.bloodMoney.title: Kuɗin Jini (Diya)
crime.i.bloodMoney.label: Tanadin Al-Qur'ani na kudin jini a lokuta da aka yi kisan gilla ko kuma afuwa.
crime.i.theft.title: Sata da Tuba
crime.i.theft.label: Alqur'ani ya shar'anta yanke hannu don sata da gafara ga tuba.
crime.i.zinaProhibited.title: An haramta Zina
crime.i.zinaProhibited.label: Alqur'ani ya haramta kusantar zina kuma ya shar'anta hukuncinta.
crime.i.zinaEvidence.title: Bukatun Shaida don Zina
crime.i.zinaEvidence.label: Alkur'ani yana bukatar shaidu hudu kuma ya ba da damar rantsuwar ma'aurata a matsayin shaida.
crime.i.noCalumny.title: An haramta zargin karya
crime.i.noCalumny.label: Alkur'ani yana azabtar da wadanda suke zargin mata masu kamun kai da karya.
crime.i.oppression.title: An La'anci Zalunci
crime.i.oppression.label: Alkur'ani ya yi tir da zalunci kuma ya yi umarni da a tsaya a kan shi.
crime.i.noOppress.title: Kar a Zalunce
crime.i.noOppress.label: Alkur'ani yana gargadi ga masu zalunci da azaba mai raɗaɗi.
crime.i.fasad.title: An Haramta Yada Cin Hanci
crime.i.fasad.label: Alkur'ani ya hana yada fasadi a cikin kasa bayan an daidaita shi.
justice.title: Adalci, Shaida & Shaidu
justice.subtitle: Nassosin Alqur'ani akan tsayuwa akan adalci, shaida na gaskiya, da shedu, da yin hukunci na gaskiya.
justice.sourceNote: Ana nuna nassoshi na adalci daga ayoyin Alqur'ani kai tsaye kawai. Babu wani ra'ayi na doka da aka samar.
justice.i.standJustly.title: A Tsaya Tsaye Kan Adalci
justice.i.standJustly.label: Alqur'ani ya yi umarni da tsayuwa tsayin daka don yin adalci a matsayin masu shaida ga Allah.
justice.i.justiceEvenAgainstSelf.title: Adalci Ko Akan Kansa
justice.i.justiceEvenAgainstSelf.label: Alkur'ani ya yi umarni da yin shaida bisa adalci ko da ya kasance a kan kanka.
justice.i.justiceForAll.title: Adalci Ga Dukkan Mutane
justice.i.justiceForAll.label: Alqur'ani ya yi umurni da kasancewa koda ga wanda kuke qi.
justice.i.doNotFollowWhims.title: Kada Ku Bi Sha'awa A Cikin Hukunci
justice.i.doNotFollowWhims.label: Alkur'ani ya hana bin sha'awa yayin bayar da shaida ko hukunci.
justice.i.truthfulTestimony.title: Shaidar Gaskiya
justice.i.truthfulTestimony.label: Alkur'ani ya yi umarni da bayar da shaida yadda ya kamata ba boye ta ba.
justice.i.doNotHide.title: Kar Ka Boye Shaida
justice.i.doNotHide.label: Alkur'ani ya hana boye shaida kuma ya kira ta da zunubi.
justice.i.twoWitnesses.title: Ana Bukatar Shaidu Biyu
justice.i.twoWitnesses.label: Al-Qur'ani na bukatar shaidu biyu kan kwangiloli, saki, da muhimman al'amura.
justice.i.marriageWitness.title: Shaidar Saki
justice.i.marriageWitness.label: Alkur'ani ya yi umarni da a dauki shaidu biyu masu adalci lokacin da ake furta saki.
justice.i.judgesFairly.title: Yi Adalci A Cikin Mutane
justice.i.judgesFairly.label: Alkur'ani ya yi umarni da yin hukunci tsakanin mutane da adalci.
justice.i.noFavourism.title: Babu fifiko a cikin hukunci
justice.i.noFavourism.label: Alkur'ani ya yi umarni da yin adalci har ga wadanda kuke so.
justice.i.equality.title: Daidaiton Dukkan Mutane
justice.i.equality.label: Alkur'ani ya ce dukkan mutane daga rai daya suke kuma mafi daukaka su ne mafi adalci.
food.title: Abinci, Abin sha & Abubuwan sa maye
food.subtitle: Nassosin Alqur'ani akan abinci halal da haram, kayan maye, yanka, da ka'idojin ci.
food.sourceNote: Ana nuna nassoshin abinci daga ayoyin Alqur'ani kai tsaye kawai. Ba a samar da hukuncin fikihu ba.
food.i.eatLawfulGood.title: Ku ci halal da mai kyau
food.i.eatLawfulGood.label: Alqur'ani ya yi umarni da cin halal mai kyau.
food.i.seafood.title: Abincin teku Halal ne
food.i.seafood.label: Alqur'ani ya halatta wasan teku a matsayin tanadin halal.
food.i.peopleOfBook.title: Abincin Ahlul Kitabi
food.i.peopleOfBook.label: Alqur'ani ya halatta abincin da Ahlul Kitabi suke yanka.
food.i.forbiddenList.title: Jerin Haramun
food.i.forbiddenList.label: Alqur'ani ya fayyace matattun dabbobi da jini da naman alade da abin da aka sadaukar da shi ga wanin Allah.
food.i.blood.title: Haramun Jini
food.i.blood.label: Alqur'ani ya hana cin jinin da aka zubar.
food.i.pork.title: An haramta naman alade
food.i.pork.label: Qur'ani ya hana naman alade karara.
food.i.deadAnimals.title: An haramta Matattu Dabbobin
food.i.deadAnimals.label: Alkur'ani ya hana cin dabbar da ta mutu ba tare da yankan da ya dace ba.
food.i.dedicatedOther.title: Sadaukarwa Ga Wanin Allah
food.i.dedicatedOther.label: Naman da aka yi wa gumaka ko wanin Allah haramun ne.
food.i.intoxicantsHaram.title: An haramta kayan sa maye
food.i.intoxicantsHaram.label: Alkur'ani ya yi umarni da nisantar abubuwan sa maye a matsayin abin kyama daga Shaidan.
food.i.gamblingForbidden.title: An haramta caca
food.i.gamblingForbidden.label: Alqur'ani ya hana caca tare da abubuwan sa maye.
food.i.sayBismillah.title: Ka ambaci sunan Allah a wurin yanka
food.i.sayBismillah.label: Alkur'ani ya yi umarni da ambaton sunan Allah a kan abin da ake yanka.
food.i.eatNotExcess.title: Ku ci kuma kada ku wuce gona da iri
food.i.eatNotExcess.label: Alkur'ani ya yi umarni da ci da sha ba tare da wuce gona da iri ba.
social.title: Dabi'ar Al'umma & Dabi'u
social.subtitle: Nassosin Alqur'ani game da keɓantawa, kunya, magana, alaƙa, da ɗabi'un gama gari a cikin al'umma.
social.sourceNote: Ana nuna nassoshi na zamantakewa daga ayoyin Alqur'ani kai tsaye kawai. Babu shawarwarin da aka samar.
social.i.permissionEnter.title: Nemi Izinin Shiga
social.i.permissionEnter.label: Alqur'ani yayi umarni da neman izini da gaisuwa kafin shiga gidaje.
social.i.noSpying.title: Babu Leken asiri
social.i.noSpying.label: Al-Qur'ani ya hana yin leken asiri ga wasu da kutsa cikin al'amuransu na sirri.
social.i.modestyMen.title: Karama ga Maza
social.i.modestyMen.label: Alqur'ani ya umurci mazaje da su runtse daga idanunsu, su kiyaye farjinta.
social.i.modestyWomen.title: Karama ga Mata
social.i.modestyWomen.label: Alkur'ani ya umurci mata da su runtse idanunsu da nuna kunya.
social.i.noMockery.title: Babu izgili
social.i.noMockery.label: Alqur'ani ya hana yin izgili da wasu mutane ko kiransu da sunaye masu banƙyama.
social.i.noBackbiting.title: Babu Guda
social.i.noBackbiting.label: Alqur'ani ya kamanta gulma da cin naman dan uwa matacce.
social.i.noSuspicion.title: Babu tuhuma
social.i.noSuspicion.label: Alkur'ani ya yi umarni da guje wa zato da yawa kamar yadda wasu zato zunubi ne.
social.i.truthSpeech.title: Fadin Gaskiya
social.i.truthSpeech.label: Alkur'ani ya yi umarni da kasancewa tare da masu gaskiya da magana madaidaiciya.
social.i.greet.title: Dawo Gaisuwa
social.i.greet.label: Alkur'ani ya yi umarni da mayar da gaisuwa da wani abu daidai ko mafi alheri.
social.i.noArrogance.title: Babu Girman Kai
social.i.noArrogance.label: Alqur'ani ya hana girman kai da tafiya da alfahari a bayan qasa.
social.i.noInsult.title: Babu Zagin Wasu
social.i.noInsult.label: Alqur'ani ya hana cin mutuncin waxanda ake girmama su domin hakan yakan kai ga cin zarafi.
social.i.beGood.title: Ka kyautata wa Wasu
social.i.beGood.label: Alkur'ani ya yi umarni da kyautatawa iyaye, dangi, makwabta, da dukkan mutane.
relations.title: Dangantaka da wadanda ba musulmi ba
relations.subtitle: Nassosin Alqur'ani akan kyautatawa, Adalci, yarjejeniyoyin, da iyakoki da waxanda ba musulmi ba.
relations.sourceNote: Ana nuna nassoshi daga ayoyin Alqur'ani kai tsaye kawai. Babu sharhin siyasa da aka haifar.
relations.i.kindnessNonHostile.title: Alheri ga Mara Kiyayya
relations.i.kindnessNonHostile.label: Al-Qur'ani ya halatta kyautatawa da adalci ga wadanda ba su yake ku ba saboda imanin ku.
relations.i.actJustly.title: Yi Adalci Ga Duka
relations.i.actJustly.label: Alqur'ani ya yi umurni da a yi adalci har ga wanda kuke qi.
relations.i.noCompulsion.title: Babu Tilastawa A Addini
relations.i.noCompulsion.label: Alkur'ani ya bayyana cewa babu tilas a addini.
relations.i.debateBest.title: Muhawara ta Mafificin Hanya
relations.i.debateBest.label: Alqur'ani ya yi umurni da yin kira zuwa ga tafarkin Allah da hikima da kyakkyawar hujja.
relations.i.doNotAid.title: Kada Ka taimaki Masu Yakarka
relations.i.doNotAid.label: Alkur'ani ya hana daukar wadanda suka yaki muminai da kuma kore su a matsayin abokan tarayya.
relations.i.honorTreaties.title: Yarjejeniyar Girmamawa
relations.i.honorTreaties.label: Alkur'ani ya yi umarni da cika alkawari da wadanda ba su warware su ba.
relations.i.breakTreaty.title: Amsa Kan Yarjejeniya Breaking
relations.i.breakTreaty.label: Alkur'ani ya bada damar kawo karshen yarjejeniya da wadanda suka warware ta.
relations.i.refugeSeeker.title: Bada mafaka ga Wanda Yake Nemanta
relations.i.refugeSeeker.label: Alqur'ani yayi umarni da bada kariya ga kafirin da ya nemi tsari.
brotherhood.title: Yan'uwantaka & Al'umma
brotherhood.subtitle: Tafsirin Alqur'ani akan hadin kan musulmi, sulhu, hadin kai, da al'ummah.
brotherhood.sourceNote: Ana nuna nassoshi na 'yan'uwantaka daga ayoyin Alqur'ani kai tsaye kawai. Babu sharhi da aka samar.
brotherhood.i.believersBrothers.title: Muminai Yan Uwa Ne
brotherhood.i.believersBrothers.label: Al-Qur'ani ya bayyana dukkan muminai 'yan'uwa ne kuma ya yi umarni da sulhu.
brotherhood.i.holdRope.title: Ku Rike Igiyar Allah Tare
brotherhood.i.holdRope.label: Alqur'ani ya yi umarni da riko da igiyar Allah gaba xaya, kada a rarraba.
brotherhood.i.doNotDivide.title: Kada Ku Raba
brotherhood.i.doNotDivide.label: Alkur'ani ya yi Allah wadai da rarrabuwar kawuna bayan shiriya bayyananna ta zo.
brotherhood.i.reconcileDispute.title: Sulhunta Masu Rikici
brotherhood.i.reconcileDispute.label: Alkur'ani ya yi umarni da yin sulhu tsakanin gungun muminai guda biyu masu jayayya.
brotherhood.i.makeSettlement.title: Zaure Yafi Kyau
brotherhood.i.makeSettlement.label: Alkur'ani ya yarda da sulhu da sulhu a kan doguwar jayayya.
brotherhood.i.cooperateGood.title: Ku hada kai cikin Alkhairi
brotherhood.i.cooperateGood.label: Alkur'ani ya yi umarni da a hada kai cikin adalci da takawa, ba cikin zunubi ba.
brotherhood.i.forbidEvil.title: Hana Mummuna Tare
brotherhood.i.forbidEvil.label: Alqur'ani ya kira muminai da su yi umarni da kyakkyawa da hani da mummuna tare.
brotherhood.i.noEnmity.title: Babu Kiyayya Tsakanin Muminai
brotherhood.i.noEnmity.label: Alkur'ani ya haramta gaba tsakanin muminai kuma yana neman gafara ga kowa da kowa.
brotherhood.i.community.title: Mafi kyawun Al'umma
brotherhood.i.community.label: Alkur'ani ya siffanta al'ummar musulmi a matsayin mafi alherin da aka fitar ga dan Adam.
oaths.title: Rantsuwa, Alkawari & Kaffara
oaths.subtitle: Tafsirin Alqur'ani akan rantsuwa, kaffararsu, zihar, ila, da cika bakance.
oaths.sourceNote: Ana nuna nassoshin rantsuwa daga ayoyin Alqur'ani kai tsaye kawai. Aikace-aikacen doka yana buƙatar ƙwararrun guraben karatu.
oaths.i.doNotMakeObstacle.title: Kada ku sanya rantsuwa ta zama cikas
oaths.i.doNotMakeObstacle.label: Al-Qur'ani ya yi gargadi game da amfani da sunan Allah a matsayin uzuri don guje wa aikata alheri.
oaths.i.laghwOath.title: Rantsuwa Ba da gangan ba
oaths.i.laghwOath.label: Alkur'ani ya bambanta rantsuwar da ba a yi niyya ba da na ganganci.
oaths.i.oathExpiation.title: Kaffarar Rantsuwa
oaths.i.oathExpiation.label: Alkur'ani ya shar'anta kaffara ga karya rantsuwa da gangan.
oaths.i.expiateFeed.title: Ciyar da Talakawa Goma
oaths.i.expiateFeed.label: Wani nau'i na kaffarar rantsuwa shine ciyarwa ko tufatar da miskinai goma.
oaths.i.expiateFasting.title: Azumi a matsayin Kaffara
oaths.i.expiateFasting.label: Idan kuma ba a iya yin wani kaffara, an wajabta azumin kwana uku.
oaths.i.ila.title: Ila - Rantsuwa
oaths.i.ila.label: Alkur'ani ya ba da wa'adin watanni hudu ga wadanda suka yi rantsuwar kaurace musu.
oaths.i.zihar.title: Zihar - Kwatanta Haramtacciyar hanya
oaths.i.zihar.label: Alqur'ani ya yi magana da zihar kuma ya kira shi da mugun nufi.
oaths.i.ziharExpiation.title: Kaffara ga Zihar
oaths.i.ziharExpiation.label: Alqur'ani ya shar'anta 'yanta bawa, ko azumi, ko ciyar da miskini domin zihari.
oaths.i.fulfillVows.title: Cika Alkawari
oaths.i.fulfillVows.label: Alqur'ani ya yabi wadanda suka cika bakance da umarnin cika su.
parents.i.orphans.title: Marayu
parents.i.orphans.label: Alkur'ani ya yi umarni da kyautatawa da kiyaye dukiyar marayu.
signs.title: Alamomin Allah a cikin Halittu
signs.subtitle: Ayoyin Alqur'ani da suke nuni da ayoyin Allah a cikin sararin samaniya, da kasa, da ruwa, da kan dan Adam, da abubuwan da suka faru na halitta.
signs.sourceNote: Ana nuna alamun daga ayoyin Alqur'ani kai tsaye kawai. AskQuran baya kara tafsirin kimiyya ko da'awar mu'ujiza.
signs.i.heavensEarth.title: Halittar sammai da ƙasa
signs.i.heavensEarth.label: Alkur'ani ya yi ishara da halittar sammai da kasa a matsayin ayoyin Allah mabayyani.
signs.i.dayNightAlternation.title: Canjin Rana da Dare
signs.i.dayNightAlternation.label: Alkur'ani ya gabatar da sauye-sauyen dare da rana a matsayin aya ga masu tunani.
signs.i.rainLife.title: Ruwan Sama Mai Ba Duniya Rai
signs.i.rainLife.label: Allah ya saukar da ruwan sama kuma ya rayar da matacciyar kasa - Alamar Alqur'ani ta tashin matattu da rahama.
signs.i.creationHumans.title: Halittar Dan Adam
signs.i.creationHumans.label: Alqur'ani yayi bayani dalla-dalla halittun dan adam daga asali masu kaskanci a matsayin alamar ikon Allah.
signs.i.soulBreathed.title: Rai da Barci
signs.i.soulBreathed.label: Allah yana hura rai a cikin surar mutum; ana kwatanta barci a matsayin ƙaramin mutuwa.
signs.i.seasRivers.title: Tekuna, koguna, da jiragen ruwa
signs.i.seasRivers.label: Alkur'ani ya yi nuni da yadda ake amfani da tekuna da koguna a matsayin alamomin tanadin Ubangiji.
signs.i.mountainsPegs.title: Duwatsu kamar Tukui
signs.i.mountainsPegs.label: Al-Qur'ani ya siffanta tsaunuka a matsayin turakun da ke daidaita kasa.
signs.i.starsNavigation.title: Taurari azaman Kewayawa
signs.i.starsNavigation.label: Alqurani ya siffanta taurari a matsayin jagorori ga masu yawo a kasa da teku.
signs.i.animalsSign.title: Dabbobi a matsayin Alamomi
signs.i.animalsSign.label: Alkur'ani ya yi nuni da shanu da kudan zuma da dabbobi a matsayin alamomin arziki da hikimar Allah.
signs.i.windClouds.title: Iska da Gajimare
signs.i.windClouds.label: Kur'ani ya siffanta iskoki a matsayin alamu - ɗauke da ruwan sama, da tuƙi, da watsa iri.
women.title: Mata a cikin Alqur'ani
women.subtitle: Nassosin Alqur'ani akan Maryam, Asiya, mata a cikin labarai, daidaiton ruhi, hakkoki, da A'isha da aka share ta hanyar wahayi.
women.sourceNote: Ana nuna nassoshi na mata daga ayoyin Alqur'ani kai tsaye kawai. Babu sharhi da aka samar.
women.i.maryamChosen.title: Maryam - Zaɓaɓɓe kuma An tsarkake
women.i.maryamChosen.label: Alqur'ani yana cewa Allah ya zavi Maryama, kuma Ya tsarkake ta, kuma Ya fifita ta a kan dukkan matan talikai.
women.i.maryamAngel.title: Mala'ika Ya Ziyarci Maryam
women.i.maryamAngel.label: Alqur'ani ya ba da labarin Mala'ikan da ya bayyana ga Maryama da kuma labarin haihuwar Isa ba tare da uba ba.
women.i.maryamBirth.title: Haihuwar Isa
women.i.maryamBirth.label: Maryam ta haihu ita kaxai, kuma Alqur’ani ya siffanta haqurin da ta yi, da mu’ujizar bishiyar dabino, da Isa yana magana daga jariri.
women.i.maryamSurah.title: Surah Maryam — Surah Mai Suna Bayanta
women.i.maryamSurah.label: Maryam itace mace daya tilo da aka ambata a cikin Alqur'ani kuma mace daya tilo da aka sanya mata sura.
women.i.asiyaPrayer.title: Addu'ar Asiya - Abin koyi ga Muminai
women.i.asiyaPrayer.label: Alkur'ani ya gabatar da Asiya, matar Fir'auna, a matsayin abin koyi: ta yi addu'a ga wani gida kusa da Allah a cikin Aljanna.
women.i.queenSheba.title: Sarauniyar Saba
women.i.queenSheba.label: Alkur'ani ya ba da labarin hikimar Sarauniyar Sheba, da kursiyinta, da mika wuya ga Allah.
women.i.wivesOfProphet.title: Zabin Da Aka Ba Matan Annabi
women.i.wivesOfProphet.label: Alkur'ani ya bai wa matan Annabi zabi tsakanin duniya da Allah - sun zabi Allah.
women.i.ifkVerses.title: A'isha ta Wahayi
women.i.ifkVerses.label: Lokacin da aka tuhumi A’isha ƙarya, Allah ya saukar da ayoyi da ke share sunanta kai tsaye – daga cikin mafi bayyanan karewar Kur’ani na kowane mutum.
women.i.equalBeliever.title: Muminai Maza da Mata Daidai Ne Ga Allah
women.i.equalBeliever.label: Alkur'ani a sarari ya lissafta muminai maza da mata kafada da kafada a matsayin masu samun ladan Allah daidai-wa-daida.
women.i.mothersHonour.title: Girmama Uwaye
women.i.mothersHonour.label: Alqur’ani ya yi umurni da kyautatawa ga iyaye masu nauyin nauyi na musamman ga uwaye, waxanda suke xauke da wahala a kan tsanani.
women.i.womenRights.title: Haqqoqin Mata A Cikin Alqur'ani
women.i.womenRights.label: Alqur'ani ya kafa haqqoqin mata a cikin aure, da kiyayewa, da gado, da 'yancin kai.
lineage.title: Ba Za a Gaji Imani ba
lineage.subtitle: Kur'ani a bayyane yake: danganta shi da annabi baya tabbatar da ceto. Bangaskiya mutum ne - kowane rai yana da alhakin abin da ya zaɓa kawai.
lineage.sourceNote: Ana zana nassoshi kai tsaye daga ayoyin Alqur'ani kawai. Babu ƙarin sharhi fiye da abin da nassi ya faɗa.
lineage.cat.wives: Matan Da Mazajensu Basu Cece Ba
lineage.i.nuhSon.title: Ɗan Nuhu - 'Ba na Gidanku ba ne'
lineage.i.nuhSon.label: Nuhu ya kira ɗansa ya shiga cikin jirgin. Ya ki ya nutse. Sa'ad da Nuhu ya yi roƙo, Allah ya amsa: "Ba ya cikin iyalinka, ayyukansa ba su kasance masu adalci ba." Mafi bayyanan bayanin Alqur'ani cewa zuri'a ba ta nufin komai a wajen Allah.
lineage.i.ibrahimFather.title: Uban Ibrahim - Annabi Bai Iya Cece Shi ba
lineage.i.ibrahimFather.label: Azar mahaifin Ibrahim ya kasance mai tsafi. Ibrahim ya yi masa addu'a da tausasawa, sa'an nan bayan da ta tabbata babansa ya rasu a kan kafirci, sai Allah ya umurci Ibrahim da ya daina - sai Ibrahim ya rabu. Kasancewar shi uban mafi girman tauhidi bai wadatar da Azar ba.
lineage.i.abuLahab.title: Abu Lahab - An La'anci Kawun Annabi Da Suna
lineage.i.abuLahab.label: Abu Lahab kawun Annabi ne. Shine mutum daya tilo da aka yankewa wuta da sunan sa a cikin Alqur'ani. Suratul Masad ya bayyana dukiyarsa kuma 'ya'yansa ba za su wadatar da shi ba - zai shiga wuta mai tsanani.
lineage.i.nuhWife.title: Matar Nuhu - Gargadi ga Kafirai
lineage.i.nuhWife.label: Alkur'ani ya gabatar da matar Nuhu a matsayin daya daga cikin misalai guda biyu ga kafirai - ta auri annabi amma ta ci amanarsa. Kusancinta da annabi bai cece ta ba. Aka ce mata: "Ki shiga wuta tare da masu shiga."
lineage.i.lutWife.title: Matar Ludu - Hagu A Baya Tare da Rushe
lineage.i.lutWife.label: An gaya wa matar Luɗu ta tafi tare da mijinta amma tana cikin waɗanda aka halaka. Kur'ani ya haɗa ta da matar Nuhu a matsayin misali biyu na gangan: mata biyu da suka auri annabawa, dukansu an hukunta su saboda zaɓin nasu.
lineage.i.abuLahabWife.title: Matar Abu Lahab - Ita ma Za ta Shiga Wuta
lineage.i.abuLahabWife.label: Kur'ani ba kawai Abu Lahab ya la'anci ba amma matarsa ​​tare da shi - ta dauki ƙaya don cutar da Annabi. Kasancewar matar baffan Annabi bai ba ta kariya ba. Za ta ɗauki itace kamar mai da igiya murɗaɗɗen zare a wuyanta.
lineage.i.asiyaContrast.title: Asiya - Matar Mummunan Mutum, Duk da haka a Aljanna
lineage.i.asiyaContrast.label: Asiya ta auri Fir'auna - wanda ya fi kowa azzalumi a cikin Kur'ani wanda ya yi iƙirarin shi ne allah. Amma duk da haka imaninta ya sa ta zama ɗaya daga cikin manyan muminai. Da gangan Alqur'ani ya haɗa labarinta da matan Nuhu da Luɗu: kusanci da mafi sharri bai lalata ta ba.
lineage.i.believingManPharaoh.title: Muminai a Gidan Fir'auna
lineage.i.believingManPharaoh.label: Wani mutum daga cikin dangin Fir’auna da na cikinsa ya ɓoye bangaskiyarsa kuma ya yi wa Musa magana, yana ba da shawara da mutanen Fir’auna. Rayuwa a tsakiyar kafiri mai karfi bai hana shi gane da kare gaskiya ba.
lineage.i.noBearer.title: Babu Rai Mai Dauki Nauyin Wani
lineage.i.noBearer.label: Alkur'ani ya bayyana ka'ida sau hudu a cikin surori daban-daban: babu wani mai kaya da ya dauki nauyin wani. Kõwane rai bã ya yin hisabi fãce da abin da ya tsirfanta. Babu annabi, iyaye, ko kakanni da zai iya ɗaukar nauyin zaɓin wani.
lineage.i.fleeFamily.title: A Wannan Ranar - Mutane Za Su Gudu Daga Iyalinsu
lineage.i.fleeFamily.label: Alkur'ani ya bayyana wani yini mai tsanani da mutum zai guje wa dan'uwansa, da mahaifiyarsa, da ubansa, da matarsa, da 'ya'yansa - kowane mutum ya cinye shi da kansa. A wannan ranar, abin da kawai mutum ya kawo wa kansa.
book.title: Littafin Allah - Alqur'ani Ya Siffanta Kansa
book.subtitle: Abin da Kur'ani ya ce game da kansa - sunayensa, manufarsa, yadda aka saukar da shi, kalubalensa ga 'yan adam, da tasirinsa a cikin zuciyar mutum.
book.sourceNote: Dukkan nassoshi an zana su kai tsaye daga ayoyin Alqur'ani. Ana nuna bayanin kansa na Al-Qur'ani a zahiri - ba a kara tafsirin waje ba.
book.i.alHuda.title: Al-Huda - The Guidance
book.i.alHuda.label: Al-Qur'ani ya kira kansa Al-Huda - shiriya ga masu takawa da kuma dukkan 'yan adam. Babban manufarsa, wanda aka bayyana a cikin ayarsa ta biyu, ita ce jagora.
book.i.alFurqan.title: Al-Furqan - Ma'auni
book.i.alFurqan.label: Alkur'ani ya kira kansa Al-Furqan - ma'auni da ke bambanta gaskiya da karya. Suratul Furqan ta buda: ''Tsarki ya tabbata ga wanda ya saukar da rarrabuwa a kan bawansa.'
book.i.alNoor.title: Al-Nuur - Haske
book.i.alNoor.label: Alkur'ani ya siffanta kansa da wani haske bayyananne daga Allah, wanda yake fitar da mutane daga duffai zuwa ga haske, da izininsa, zuwa tafarkin mabuwayi, abin godiya.
book.i.alShifa.title: Al-Shifa - The Healing
book.i.alShifa.label: Kur'ani ya bayyana kansa waraka ga abin da ke cikin ƙiraza - rahama ga muminai. Yana warkar da shakka, cututtuka na zuciya, da cututtuka na ruhaniya.
book.i.alDhikr.title: Al-Dhikr - Tunatarwa
book.i.alDhikr.label: Al-Qur'ani ya kira kansa Al-Dhikr - Tunatarwa. A cikin ayar nan kuma Allah yana cewa: "Kuma lalle ne, hakika, Mu ne Muka saukar da Ambato (Alkur'ani), kuma lalle ne Mu ne Majibintansa."
book.i.alMubeen.title: Al-Kitab Al-Mubeen - Littafi Mai Tsarki
book.i.alMubeen.label: Alqur'ani ya buɗe surori da yawa tare da cewa: 'Ina rantsuwa da Littafi Mabayyani.' Al-Mubeen yana nufin bayyananne, bayyananne, da bayyanawa - duka a cikinsa da abin da yake bayyanawa ga wasu.
book.i.alAzeemMajid.title: Al-Azeem & Al-Majid - Maɗaukaki, Mai ɗaukaka
book.i.alAzeemMajid.label: Allah Ya siffanta Al-Qur'ani da Al-Azeem (Mai girma - 15:87) da Al-Majid (Mai daukaka - 85:21). Wadannan suna daga cikin manya-manyan lakabin daraja da ake amfani da su ga kowane halittun Allah.
book.i.alHakim.title: Al-Kitab Al-Hakim - Littafin Hikima
book.i.alHakim.label: Al-Qur'ani ana kiransa Al-Hakim - Littafin Hikima, mai hikima. Suratun Ya-Sin ta bude: 'Ina rantsuwa da Al-Qur'ani Mai hikima.' Hikimar da ke cikinta daga Allah ne, Masani.
book.i.guidanceForMankind.title: Shiriya ga Dukan Mutane
book.i.guidanceForMankind.label: An aiko Alqur'ani ya zama shiriya ga dukkan bil'adama. Suratul Baqarah (2:185) ta ce, an aiko ta ne domin shiriya ga mutane, da hujjoji bayyanannu na shiriya da rarrabewa.
book.i.confirmsPrevious.title: Yana Tabbatarwa da Kiyaye Nassosin Da Ya gabata
book.i.confirmsPrevious.label: Alkur'ani ya bayyana cewa yana tabbatar da Attaura da Linjila kuma ya tsaya a matsayin majibinci ga dukkan littattafan da suka gabata. Ba ta zo don maye gurbin gaskiya ba - ya zo ne don kammalawa da kare ta.
book.i.warnerGivesGladTidings.title: Gargadi kuma Mai Ba da Bishara
book.i.warnerGivesGladTidings.label: Alkur'ani ya siffanta kansa a matsayin mai shiryarwa zuwa ga gaskiya - mai yin bushara ga muminai wadanda suka kyautata, da gargadin wadanda suka ce Allah ya dauki da.
book.i.revealedGradually.title: Me Yasa Aka Bayyana A hankali Sama da Shekaru 23
book.i.revealedGradually.label: A lokacin da kafirai suka tambayi dalilin da ya sa ba a saukar da shi gaba daya ba, sai Alkur'ani ya ce: "Dõmin Mu ƙarfafa zuciyarka da shi, kuma Muka sanya shi bayyananne." Ya zo cikin matakan da suka dace da abubuwan da suka faru.
book.i.revealedInArabic.title: Me Yasa Aka Saukar Da Larabci
book.i.revealedInArabic.label: Alkur'ani ya bayyana cewa an saukar da shi da Larabci bayyananne domin mutane su fahimta kuma su yi tunani. Daga Ubangijin talikai ne, Ruhi amintacce ya saukar da shi a cikin zuciyar Annabi.
book.i.laylatalQadr.title: Wanda aka saukar a daren Lailatul Kadri
book.i.laylatalQadr.label: Al-Qur'ani ya siffanta darensa na saukarsa - Lailatul Kadri (Lailatul Qadari), wanda ya fi watanni dubu. A wannan dare mai albarka mala'iku da ruhi suna sauka da iznin Allah.
book.i.tahaddi.title: The Tahaddi — Kawo Surah Guda Kamar Haka
book.i.tahaddi.label: Alkur'ani ya gabatar da kalubale a tsaye: Ku kirayi dukkan shaidunku, baicin Allah, kuma ku zo da sura guda daya kwatankwacinsa - idan kun kasance masu gaskiya. Mutane da aljanu tare ba za su iya ba. Idan ba za ku iya ba, kuma ba za ku so ba, to, ku ji tsoron wuta.
book.i.protected.title: Allah Ya Tabbatar Mana Da Kiyayeshi
book.i.protected.label: Allah Yana cewa: "Lalle ne Mu ne Muka saukar da Ambato, kuma Mu ne Majibintansa." Qarya ba ta iya kusantar Alqur'ani daga gaba gare shi ko a bayansa, wahayi ne daga Mai hikima, Gõdadde.
book.i.mountainHumbles.title: Dutsen Zai Kaskantar da Kansa
book.i.mountainHumbles.label: Allah yana cewa: Da Mun saukar da wannan Alqur'ani a kan dutse, da ka gan shi yana mai kaskantar da kai, kuma yana tsagewa, ba tare da tsoron Allah ba. Waɗancan misãlai ne Allah Ya buga dõmin mutãne su yi tunãni.
book.i.skinsHeartsHumble.title: Fatu da Zukata suna yin laushi
book.i.skinsHeartsHumble.label: Allah Ya siffanta Al-Qur'ani cewa: "Fatun wadanda suka bi Ubangijinsu suna karkarwa daga gare shi, sai fatunsu da zukatansu su yi laushi zuwa ga ambaton Allah." Yana aiki akan jiki da ruhi.
book.i.increasesIman.title: Yana Qarawa Muminai Imani
book.i.increasesIman.label: Alkur'ani ya bayyana cewa, idan aka karanta ayoyinsa, muminai na hakika suna karuwa da imani. Suratul Tawbah tana tambaya: "Kuma wadanda suka yi imani, ta kara musu imani."
sabr.title: Sabr & Shukr - Hakuri & Godiya
sabr.subtitle: Nassosin Alqur'ani akan haquri (Sabri) da godiya (Shukr) - nau'i, lada, misalan annabawa, da godiya ga Allah.
sabr.sourceNote: Nassoshi Sabru da Shukr ana nuna su daga ayoyin Alqur'ani kai tsaye kawai. Babu nasihar addini da aka samar.
sabr.i.sabrWithPrayer.title: Neman Taimako Ta Hakuri da Addu'a
sabr.i.sabrWithPrayer.label: Alqur'ani ya yi umarni da neman taimako ta hanyar sabar da salah - hakuri yana da alaƙa kai tsaye da ibada.
sabr.i.beautifulPatience.title: Kyawawan Hakuri (Sabrun Jameel)
sabr.i.beautifulPatience.label: Yakubu ya nuna Sabrun Jameel - hakurin da ba ya kai karar halitta, sai ga Allah.
sabr.i.sabrOnTrials.title: Hakuri Karkashin Gwaji
sabr.i.sabrOnTrials.label: Alkur'ani ya yi alkawarin cewa wadanda suka yi hakuri a cikin asara da wahala suna samun albarka da rahama daga Allah.
sabr.i.allahWithPatient.title: Kuma Allah Yanã tãre da mãsu haƙuri
sabr.i.allahWithPatient.label: Kur'ani ya maimaita cewa: 'Lalle ne, Allah yana tare da masu hakuri.'
sabr.i.rewardWithoutAccount.title: Kyauta Ba tare da Aunawa ba
sabr.i.rewardWithoutAccount.label: Alkur'ani ya yi alkawarin cewa majiyyaci za su samu ladarsu ba tare da lissafi ko iyaka ba.
sabr.i.shukrIncrease.title: Idan Kayi Godiya, Zan Kara Ka
sabr.i.shukrIncrease.label: Ayar godiya mafi shahara: Allah ya yi alkawarin karawa mai godiya kuma ya yi gargadin azabar rashin godiya.
sabr.i.shukrToParents.title: Godiya ga Allah da Iyaye Tare
sabr.i.shukrToParents.label: Alkur'ani ya danganta godiya ga Allah kai tsaye tare da godiya da kyautatawa ga iyaye.
sabr.i.shukrOrKufr.title: Godiya ko rashin godiya - Zabi
sabr.i.shukrOrKufr.label: Alkur'ani ya tsara shukr a matsayin zabi na gangan; rashin godiya an tsara shi azaman nau'i na kin amincewa.
sabr.i.ayyubPatience.title: Hakurin Ayyub cikin Wahala
sabr.i.ayyubPatience.label: Ayyub ya yi kira ga Allah a cikin wahalarsa ba tare da yanke kauna ba; Allah ya sauwake masa, ya mayar masa.
sabr.i.yaqubPatience.title: Hakurin Yakub Akan Yusuf
sabr.i.yaqubPatience.label: Yakub ya ajiye bakin cikinsa tsakaninsa da Allah, yana mai nuna cewa sabar ba rashin ji bane.
sabr.i.nuhPatience.title: Hakurin Nuhu Sama da Shekaru 950
sabr.i.nuhPatience.label: Kur'ani ya kwatanta Nuhu yana kiran mutanensa tsawon shekaru 950 - aiki mafi tsayi da aka rubuta na juriya.
knowledge.title: Ilimi & Hikima
knowledge.subtitle: Nassosin Alqur'ani akan neman ilimi da hikima (Hikmah) da alqalami da malamai da hani akan bin zato.
knowledge.sourceNote: Nassoshi ilimi da hikima ana nuna su daga ayoyin Alqur'ani kai tsaye kawai. Babu wani ra'ayi na ilimi da aka samar.
knowledge.i.iqra.title: Iqra — Wahayi ta Farko
knowledge.i.iqra.label: Kalmomin farko da aka saukar wa Annabi umarni ne na karantawa, da sunan Allah wanda ya koyar da alkalami.
knowledge.i.taughtByPen.title: Allah Ya karantar da Alqalami
knowledge.i.taughtByPen.label: Alkur'ani ya tabbatar da cewa Allah ya koyar da abin da mutane ba su sani ba - ta alkalami da wahayi.
knowledge.i.increaseKnowledge.title: Dua: Ya Ubangiji Ka Kara mini Ilimi
knowledge.i.increaseKnowledge.label: Alqur'ani ya rubuta umarni kai tsaye don roƙon Allah ya ƙara ilimi - irin wannan addu'ar kawai don haɓaka mutum.
knowledge.i.knowDontKnow.title: Waɗanda suka sani daidai suke da waɗanda basu sani ba?
knowledge.i.knowDontKnow.label: Al-Qur'ani ya yi tambaya cikin rarrabuwar kawuna ko wadanda suka sani da wadanda ba su daidaita ba - kuma ya amsa a fili cewa ba haka suke ba.
knowledge.i.fearFromKnowledge.title: Ma'abuta ilimi ne kawai suke tsoron Allah
knowledge.i.fearFromKnowledge.label: Alkur'ani ya bayyana cewa a cikin bayin Allah, masu ilimi (malamai) ne kawai suke tsoronsa da gaske.
knowledge.i.askPeopleOfKnowledge.title: Ka tambayi Ma'abuta Ilimi
knowledge.i.askPeopleOfKnowledge.label: Alkur'ani ya umurci wadanda ba su sani ba da su tambayi ma'abuta ilmi.
knowledge.i.wisdomGiven.title: Hikima babbar baiwa ce
knowledge.i.wisdomGiven.label: Alqur'ani ya siffanta Hikmah (hikima) a matsayin wata falala mai girman gaske da Allah ya ba wanda ya so.
knowledge.i.luqmanWisdom.title: Hikimar Lukman
knowledge.i.luqmanWisdom.label: Alqur'ani ya kiyaye hikimar Lukman - godiya ga Allah, nisantar shirka, girmama iyaye, rashin girman kai.
knowledge.i.unseen.title: Mabudan Gaibu
knowledge.i.unseen.label: Alqur'ani ya bambanta tsakanin abin da ɗan adam zai iya sani da abin da Allah kaɗai ya sani - iyakokin ilimin ɗan adam.
knowledge.i.forbiddenConjecture.title: An haramta bin zato
knowledge.i.forbiddenConjecture.label: Al-Qur'ani ya yi kashedi sosai game da bin Zann ( zato) a cikin lamuran addini - ingantaccen ilimi ne kawai abin karba.
knowledge.i.writingContract.title: Aya mafi tsayi: Rubuta Kwangilar ku
knowledge.i.writingContract.label: Ayar Kur'ani mafi tsayi a cikin aya guda ta yi umarni da rubuta kwangiloli da basussuka a matsayin aiki na adalci da nauyi.
jinn.title: Jinn & Shaidan
jinn.subtitle: Kissoshin Aljanu da Aljanu, da kin Iblis, da kiyayyar Shaidan, da kariya daga yaudararsa.
jinn.sourceNote: An zana dukkan asusun kai tsaye daga ayoyin Alqur'ani. Nassosin hadisi akan aljani ba a cire su ba.
angels.title: Mala'iku a cikin Alqur'ani
angels.subtitle: Bayanin Alƙur'ani game da mala'iku - yanayinsu, mala'iku masu suna, matsayinsu, da dangantakarsu da ɗan adam.
angels.sourceNote: Siffofin Al-Qur'ani ne kawai aka haɗa da matsayi. Ba a jera asusu na Hadisi kawai ba.
heart.title: Zuciya a cikin Alqur'ani
heart.subtitle: Ayoyin Alqur'ani a kan yanayin zuciyar mutum - rufaffen zukata, tsarkakakkun zukata, zukata masu tunawa, da zukata da cuta ta kama.
heart.sourceNote: An nuna ayoyi a zahiri daga Alqur'ani. Zuciya (qalb) ita ce cibiyar ruhi a harshen Alqur'ani.
death.title: Mutuwa & Barzakh
death.subtitle: Ayoyin Alqur'ani akan tabbacin mutuwa, da xaukewar rai, da Barzakh, da shahidai, da komawa ga Allah.
death.sourceNote: An zana batutuwa daga ayoyin Alqur'ani kai tsaye kawai. Cikakken bayani daga hadisin akan kabari ba a nan.
yusuf.title: Labarin Yusuf
yusuf.subtitle: Cikakken labarin Alqur'ani na Annabi Yusuf - cin amana, jarrabawa, hakuri, da daukaka. Kur'ani ya kira shi 'mafi kyawun labarai'.
yusuf.sourceNote: An ba da labarin kusan gaba ɗaya a cikin suratu Yusuf (12). Ana nuna fastoci a zahiri daga Alqur'ani.
musa.title: Labarin Musa
musa.subtitle: Kissan Alqur'ani na Annabi Musa - tun daga haifuwarsa har ya fuskanci Fir'auna, da Fitowa, da Alkawari a Sinai.
musa.sourceNote: An zana abubuwan da suka faru daga surorin Alqur'ani da yawa. Ana nuna ayoyi da baki; cikakkun bayanai sun bambanta a cikin tafsirin Alqur'ani.
ibrahim.title: Labarin Ibrahim
ibrahim.subtitle: Hadisin Ibrahim – baban tauhidi – daga kiransa ga gumaka zuwa gina Ka’aba da gadonsa na Hanif.
ibrahim.sourceNote: Labarin Ibrahim ya zo a cikin surori da yawa. Ana nuna fastoci a zahiri daga Alqur'ani.
cave.title: Mutanen Kogo
cave.subtitle: Kissar Alqur'ani ta matasan da suka gudu zuwa wani kogo saboda imaninsu, tare da sauran manyan kissoshi na suratul Kahf.
cave.sourceNote: Dukkan hikayoyi daga Suratul Kahf (18) suke. Ana nuna abubuwan wucewa da baki.
modesty.title: Girman Kai & Hijabi
modesty.subtitle: Jagoran Alqur'ani akan runtse ido, tufafi masu kyau, tsafta, da dokokin sirrin dangi.
modesty.sourceNote: An zana hukunce-hukunce kai tsaye daga ayoyin Qur'ani. Ba a lissafta abubuwan da suka samo asali na Fiqhu da ra’ayoyin malamai kan ka’idojin tufafi.
arrogance.title: Girman kai & Girman kai
arrogance.subtitle: Gargadin Alqur'ani game da kibri (girman kai) - daga Iblis zuwa ga Fir'auna har zuwa Qaruna - da kira zuwa ga tawali'u.
arrogance.sourceNote: An ciro dukkan nassoshi daga ayoyin Alqur'ani. Kalmar kibr ta ƙunshi girman kai da girman kai a cikin amfani da Alqur'ani.
backbiting.title: Bata & Zagi
backbiting.subtitle: Gargadin Al-Qur'ani game da Gheebah (lalata), zage-zage, izgili, zato, da zargin karya.
backbiting.sourceNote: Dukkan nassoshi daga ayoyin Alqur'ani ne. Kwatancen da ke cikin 49:12 yana daga cikin mafi girman hani da Alqur'ani ya yi na zamantakewa.
tawakkul.title: Tawakkul - Tawakkali ga Allah
tawakkul.subtitle: Nassosin Alqur'ani game da dogaro ga Allah - AlkawarinSa ga masu tawakkali, tawakkali da annabawa, da Tawakkul da aiki.
tawakkul.sourceNote: Ana nuna nassoshi na Tawakkul daga ayoyin Alqur'ani kai tsaye kawai. Babu nasihar addini da aka samar.
tawakkul.i.allahuWakeel.title: Allah Yã isa zama Wakeel
tawakkul.i.allahuWakeel.label: Alkur'ani ya siffanta wadanda suka ce 'Allah ya ishe mu' idan aka yi mana barazana - kuma ana samun lada.
tawakkul.i.whoeverTrusts.title: Wanda ya dõgara ga Allah, to, Ma'ishinsa ne
tawakkul.i.whoeverTrusts.label: Ayar Tawakkul da aka fi kawowa: Duk wanda ya dogara ga Allah, to, Ma'ishinsa ne.
tawakkul.i.birdsExample.title: Tsuntsaye Masu Tawakkali Akan Arzikin Allah
tawakkul.i.birdsExample.label: Al-Qur'ani ya siffanta tsuntsayen da suke tashi da safe suna dogara ga Allah - kuma suna dawowa gaba daya.
tawakkul.i.ibrahimFamily.title: Dogarar Ibrahim Yana Bar Iyalinsa
tawakkul.i.ibrahimFamily.label: Ibrahim ya bar iyalansa a wani kwari maras iyaka yana dogara ga Allah ya azurta su.
tawakkul.i.musaTrustsAllah.title: Dogaron Musa A Gaban Fir'auna
tawakkul.i.musaTrustsAllah.label: Musa ya ayyana tawakkali ga Allah ko da a cikin kwana tsakanin teku da rundunar Fir'auna.
tawakkul.i.hudReliance.title: Sanarwar Dogaro da Hud
tawakkul.i.hudReliance.label: Hudu ya ce: 'Na dogara ga Allah Ubangijina kuma Ubangijinku.'
tawakkul.i.nuhReliance.title: Dogarorin Nuhu da Tsarewar Hukuncin
tawakkul.i.nuhReliance.label: Nuhu ya bayyana tawakkali ga Allah kuma ya ki mutanensa su girgiza.
tawakkul.i.makeDecision.title: Ku Shawara, Ku Yanke, Sannan Ku Dogara ga Allah
tawakkul.i.makeDecision.label: Al-Qur'ani ya yi umarni da cewa: Ku yi shawara, ku yanke hukunci, sannan ku dogara ga Allah - Tawakkul yana zuwa bayan kokari.
tawakkul.i.dontSlacken.title: Kada Ka Slacken - Amincewa da Yi aiki
tawakkul.i.dontSlacken.label: Alkur'ani ya hana rauni ko rangwame yayin da yake umarni da dogaro ga Allah tare da aiki.
tawakkul.i.duaOfProphet.title: Addu'ar Tawakkali
tawakkul.i.duaOfProphet.label: Addu'o'in annabawa da suka dogara ga Allah shi kadai.
worship.i.tahajjud.title: Sallar Dare (Tahajjud)
worship.i.tahajjud.label: Alqur'ani ya umurci Annabi da ya tashi da daddare domin karin sallah, kuma ya yabi wadanda suka bar makwancinsu da ibada.
worship.i.khushu.title: Tawali'u da Halartan Sallah (Khushu)
worship.i.khushu.label: Alqurani ya bayyana cewa muminai waxanda suka yi tawakkali a cikin sallarsu sun sami rabauta.
worship.i.laylatAlQadr.title: Lailatul Qadr - Lailatul Qadri
worship.i.laylatAlQadr.label: Alqur'ani ya bayyana daren Lailatul Qadri fiye da watanni dubu; a cikinta Mala'iku suna sauka da iznin Allah.
worship.i.itikaaf.title: I’itikafi — Keɓewa a cikin Masallaci
worship.i.itikaaf.label: Alqur’ani ya ambaci zama a masallaci domin ibada; an kebe masallacin Harami ne domin tsarkakewa da ibada.
worship.i.prayerTimes.title: lokutan Sallah
worship.i.prayerTimes.label: Alqur'ani ya ambaci lokuta na musamman - safiya, rana, rana, yamma, da dare - a matsayin lokutan tasbihi da sallah.
doj.cat.death: Mutuwa & Abin da Ya biyo baya
doj.i.deathCertain.title: Kowanne rai zai dandani mutuwa
doj.i.deathCertain.label: Alqur'ani ya bayyana cewa kowane rai zai ɗanɗani mutuwa, kuma a Ranar Ƙiyama za a cika musu sakamakonsu.
doj.i.timeFixed.title: Ana Kayyade Sa'ar Mutuwa
doj.i.timeFixed.label: Alqur'ani ya bayyana cewa kowace al'umma da kowane mutum yana da ajali ambatacce wanda ba ya iya gaba ko jinkirtawa.
doj.i.barzakh.title: Barzakh - Shamaki Har Zuwa Tashin Kiyama
doj.i.barzakh.label: Alqur’ani ya yi bayanin wani shamaki tsakanin mutuwa da tashin qiyama, wanda babu wani rai da zai koma da shi, kuma a cikinsa ake nuna wa mutanen Fir’auna wuta.
doj.i.martyrsAlive.title: Shahidai Suna Raye Ba Matattu ba
doj.i.martyrsAlive.label: Alkur'ani ya yi umarni da kada a ce wadanda aka kashe a tafarkin Allah matattu ne - suna da rai, Ubangijinsu ya azurta su.
social.i.neighbourRights.title: Hakkin Maƙwabta
social.i.neighbourRights.label: Alqur'ani ya yi umarni da ihsani ga makwabci makusanci, makwabci na nesa, da sahabi a gefensa.
social.i.trustsAmanah.title: Bada Amana ga Masu su
social.i.trustsAmanah.label: Alkur'ani ya yi umarni da a ba da amana ga wadanda suke nasu kuma ya yi umarni da yin hukunci tsakanin mutane da adalci.
social.i.reconcile.title: Ayi sulhu Tsakanin Muminai
social.i.reconcile.label: Alkur'ani ya umurci muminai da su yi sulhu tsakanin bangarorin da ke jayayya, kamar yadda muminai 'yan uwantaka ne.
signs.i.humanDesignSign.title: Alamomi A Cikin Kanku
signs.i.humanDesignSign.label: Alkur'ani ya bayyana cewa alamu suna cikin dan Adam shi kansa, kuma an halicci mutane a cikin mafi kyawu.
signs.i.khalifaEarth.title: Dan Adam a matsayin Masu kula da Duniya
signs.i.khalifaEarth.label: Alkur'ani ya bayyana cewa Allah ya sanya 'yan Adam magada a bayan kasa, wanda aka dora masa alhakinsa.
signs.i.doNotCorrupt.title: Kada Ku Yada Cin Hanci A Duniya
signs.i.doNotCorrupt.label: Alkur'ani ya hana yada fasadi a bayan kasa bayan an tsara shi.
signs.i.diversitySign.title: Bambancin Harsuna da Launuka
signs.i.diversitySign.label: Alkur'ani ya gabatar da bambancin harsunan mutane da launuka a matsayin alamar Allah ga masu ilimi.
sabr.i.doNotWeaken.title: Kada Ku Rage Ko Bakin ciki
sabr.i.doNotWeaken.label: Alkur'ani ya umurci muminai da kada su yi rauni ko baqin ciki, domin su ne mafifita idan sun kasance muminai da gaske.
sabr.i.afterDifficultyEase.title: Tare Da Wahala Yana Zuwa Sauƙi
sabr.i.afterDifficultyEase.label: Alkur'ani sau biyu yana tabbatar da cewa a kowane tsanani akwai sauki, kuma Allah ba Ya kallafa wa rai fiye da karfinsa.
sabr.i.dontDespairAllah.title: Karka yanke kauna daga Ta'aziyar Allah
sabr.i.dontDespairAllah.label: Alkur'ani ya tabbatar da cewa Allah bai bar Annabi ba, kuma ya umarci muminai da kada su yanke kauna daga rahamar Allah.
sabr.i.complaintToAllah.title: Maida Bakin ciki Ga Allah Shi kadai
sabr.i.complaintToAllah.label: Yakub ya ce ya kai kara ga Allah ne kawai game da bakin cikinsa; Ayyub ya koma ga Allah a cikin wahalar da ya sha maimakon yanke kauna.
jinn.i.jinnCreatedFire.title: An Halitta Aljani daga Wuta
jinn.i.jinnCreatedFire.label: Alkur'ani ya bayyana cewa, an halicci aljani daga wuta, sabanin mutane da aka halicce su daga yumbu.
jinn.i.jinnAndHumans.title: Aljani da Mutane Tare
jinn.i.jinnAndHumans.label: Alkur'ani ya yi magana a kan aljanu da mutane a matsayin halittun da aka halicce su domin su bauta wa Allah da kuma hisabi.
jinn.i.iblisRefusal.title: Qin Iblis Yayi Sujjada
jinn.i.iblisRefusal.label: Alqur'ani ya ba da labarin cewa Iblis ya ƙi yin sujada ga Adamu, yana mai nuni da asalinsa daga wuta a matsayin fifiko.
jinn.i.iblisRespite.title: Iblis ya nemi jinkiri
jinn.i.iblisRespite.label: Alqur'ani yana cewa Iblis ya roqi Allah da ya yi masa jinkiri har zuwa ranar qiyama, wanda aka yi masa.
jinn.i.shaytanVow.title: Alkawarin Shaidan na Batar da shi
jinn.i.shaytanVow.label: Alqurani ya rubuta rantsuwar Shaidan na neman kusantar mutane daga kowane bangare domin ya batar da su, face bayin Allah salihai.
jinn.i.shaytanOpenEnemy.title: Shaidan Makiyi ne Budaddi
jinn.i.shaytanOpenEnemy.label: Alqurani ya sha bayyana Shaidan a matsayin makiyi bayyananne ga diyan Adam.
jinn.i.shaytanNoPower.title: Shaidan Ba Ya Da Iko Akan Muminai Na Gaskiya
jinn.i.shaytanNoPower.label: Alqur'ani ya bayyana cewa Shaidan ba shi da wani iko a kan wadanda suka yi imani da Allah da gaske kuma suka dogara.
jinn.i.shaytanWhispers.title: Shaidan yayi waswasi
jinn.i.shaytanWhispers.label: Alqur'ani ya siffanta Shaidan yana waswasi ga Adamu da Hauwa'u a cikin Aljanna, da yin waswasi a cikin zukatan mutane.
jinn.i.shaytanBeautifiesEvil.title: Shaidan yana qawata munanan ayyuka
jinn.i.shaytanBeautifiesEvil.label: Alqur'ani ya bayyana cewa, Shaidan ya sanya kyawawa ga wadanda suka bata.
jinn.i.seekRefuge.title: Ku nemi mafaka ga Allah
jinn.i.seekRefuge.label: Alqur’ani ya umurci muminai da su nemi tsarin Allah idan Shaidan ya umarce shi, kuma Shi ne Mai ji, Masani.
jinn.i.jinnListened.title: Aljani Mai Sauraron Alqur'ani
jinn.i.jinnListened.label: Alqur'ani ya ce: wasu aljanu sun saurari karatun Alqur'ani kuma suka yi imani suna mamakin shiriyarsa.
jinn.i.jinnSubmitted.title: Jinn Wanda Ya Gabatar
jinn.i.jinnSubmitted.label: Al-Qur'ani ya rubuta aljanu muminai suna bayyana biyayyarsu ga Allah da kiran mutanensu zuwa ga shiriya.
jinn.i.shaytanJudgmentDay.title: Shaidan ya barranta da Mabiyansa Ranar Alkiyama
jinn.i.shaytanJudgmentDay.label: Alqur'ani ya rubuta shaidan yayi wa mabiyansa jawabi a ranar kiyama, yana mai cewa ba shi da wani iko a kansu kuma yana musun hakan.
angels.i.angelsObeyAllah.title: Mala'iku Ba sa Sabawa Allah
angels.i.angelsObeyAllah.label: Alkur'ani ya bayyana cewa mala'iku ba sa saba wa Allah a cikin abin da ya umarce su, suna aiwatar da dukkan abin da aka umarce su.
angels.i.angelsWorshipConstantly.title: Mala'iku Suna Bautawa Allah Dawwama
angels.i.angelsWorshipConstantly.label: Alkur'ani ya siffanta mala'iku a tsaye a sahu-sahu suna tasbihi ga Allah, ba sa gajiyawa ko girman kai.
angels.i.jibreelTrustworthy.title: Jibril - Ruhu Mai Amintacce
angels.i.jibreelTrustworthy.label: Alkur'ani ya bayyana Jibrilu a matsayin ruhi mai aminci wanda ya saukar da wahayi zuwa zuciyar Annabi, yana da iko mai girma.
angels.i.mikailMentioned.title: Mikail - An ambaci sunansa
angels.i.mikailMentioned.label: Alkur’ani ya ambaci sunan Mika’ilu tare da Jibrilu, inda ya bayyana cewa duk wanda yake makiyin wadannan Mala’iku makiyin Allah ne.
angels.i.angelsWithRevelation.title: Mala'iku suna saukowa da wahayi
angels.i.angelsWithRevelation.label: Alkur'ani ya bayyana cewa a daren Lailatul kadari mala'iku da ruhi suna sauka, kuma ruhi amintacce ne ya saukar da sako.
angels.i.recordingAngels.title: Rikodin Mala'iku
angels.i.recordingAngels.label: Alkur'ani ya ce mala'iku biyu suna rubuta kowace kalma da mutum ya fada, kuma kowane rai yana da majibinci a kanta.
angels.i.angelOfDeath.title: Mala'ikan Mutuwa
angels.i.angelOfDeath.label: Alkur'ani ya bayyana cewa mala'ikan mutuwa da aka nada a kan mutane yana daukar ransu a lokacin da aka qaddara.
angels.i.guardianAngels.title: Mala'iku masu gadi
angels.i.guardianAngels.label: Alkur'ani ya siffanta mala'iku da aka nada a kan mutane a matsayin magada wadanda suke kiyaye su da umarnin Allah.
angels.i.angelsAtBadr.title: Mala'iku a Badar
angels.i.angelsAtBadr.label: Alkur'ani ya bayyana cewa Allah ya karfafa muminai a Badar da dubunnan mala'iku kuma ya jefa tsoro a cikin zukatan kafirai.
angels.i.angelsAtTheHour.title: Mala'iku a Sa'a
angels.i.angelsAtTheHour.label: Alqur’ani ya siffanta Mala’iku masu xauke da Al’arshin Allah, suna kewaye da ita, da busa qaho da mala’ika naxaxe.
angels.i.angelsPrayForBelievers.title: Mala'iku suna yin addu'a ga muminai
angels.i.angelsPrayForBelievers.label: Alqur’ani yana cewa Allah da Mala’ikunSa suna yin salati ga muminai, kuma mala’ikun da ke xauke da Al’arshi suna neman gafara ga waxanda suka yi imani.
angels.i.angelsInParadise.title: Mala'iku a Aljannah
angels.i.angelsInParadise.label: Alkur'ani ya yi bayanin yadda mala'iku suke shiga kan 'yan Aljanna daga kowace kofa, suna gaishe su da sallama.
heart.i.soundHeart.title: Sautin Zuciya
heart.i.soundHeart.label: Alkur'ani ya bayyana cewa, wanda ya je wa Allah da tsarkin zuciya, zai amfana ranar kiyama.
heart.i.heartsRemember.title: Zukata Masu Tunawa
heart.i.heartsRemember.label: Alkur'ani ya bayyana cewa a cikin ambaton Allah ne zukata suke samun natsuwa da hutawa.
heart.i.allahKnowsHearts.title: Allah Masani ne ga abin da ke cikin zukata
heart.i.allahKnowsHearts.label: Alqur'ani ya maimaita cewa Allah yana sanin abin da ke boye a cikin zukata da abin da qirji ke boyewa.
heart.i.sealedHearts.title: Rufe Zukata
heart.i.sealedHearts.label: Alkur'ani ya siffanta Allah da ya rufe zukatan kafirai don kada su fahimta, a sakamakon kinsu.
heart.i.hardenedHearts.title: Taurare zukata
heart.i.hardenedHearts.label: Alkur'ani ya kwatanta zukata masu kaurin zuciya da dutse ko mafi tsanani, kuma ya yi gargadin cewa wadanda zukatansu suka kafe suna cikin bata bayyananna.
heart.i.heartsVeiled.title: Zukata sun lulluɓe daga gaskiya
heart.i.heartsVeiled.label: Alkur'ani ya bayyana cewa, an sanya sutura a kan zukatan wadanda suka kafirta, tare da hana su fahimtar Alkur'ani.
heart.i.diseaseInHeart.title: Cuta a cikin Zuciya
heart.i.diseaseInHeart.label: Alqur'ani ya siffanta munafunci da shakku a matsayin cuta a cikin zuciya, wanda Allah ke qarawa masu dawwama a cikinta.
heart.i.tranquilityDescends.title: Natsuwa Ta Sauka A Zuciya
heart.i.tranquilityDescends.label: Alkur'ani ya ce Allah ya saukar da natsuwa a cikin zukatan muminai domin ya kara musu imani.
heart.i.heartsAtMention.title: Zukata sun yi rawar jiki ga ambaton Allah
heart.i.heartsAtMention.label: Alkur'ani ya siffanta muminai na gaskiya da cewa wadanda idan an ambaci Allah zukatansu ke firgita, kuma idan an karanta ayoyinsa imaninsu yana karuwa.
heart.i.fearAndHope.title: Tsoro da Fata a Zuciya
heart.i.fearAndHope.label: Alkur'ani ya siffanta zukatan masu ibada da cewa suna hada tsoro da buri, yana sanya su tashi daga barci zuwa ibada.
heart.i.turningHearts.title: Juyawar Zukata
heart.i.turningHearts.label: Alkur'ani ya rubuta addu'ar rokon Allah kada ya bar zukata su karkace bayan shiriya, kuma ya bayyana cewa Allah yana shiga tsakanin mutum da zuciyarsa.
heart.i.blindHearts.title: Makafin Zukata
heart.i.blindHearts.label: Alkur'ani ya bayyana cewa ba idanu ba su makanta amma zukatan da ke cikin kirji, kuma ya yi tambaya kan me ya sa ba sa tunani a kan Alkur'ani.
death.i.everySoulTastesDeath.title: Kowanne rai zai dandani mutuwa
death.i.everySoulTastesDeath.label: Alqur'ani ya bayyana cewa kowane rai zai ɗanɗani mutuwa, kuma duk wani abin halitta tabbas halaka ne.
death.i.timeOfDeathFixed.title: An Kayyade Lokacin Mutuwa
death.i.timeOfDeathFixed.label: Alkur'ani ya bayyana cewa kowace al'umma da kowane mutum yana da wani ajali wanda ba zai iya ci gaba ko jinkirtawa ba.
death.i.soulTakenByAngel.title: Mala'ika Ya Dauke Rai
death.i.soulTakenByAngel.label: Alkur'ani ya bayyana cewa mala'ikan mutuwa da mala'ikun da ya nada suna daukar rayuka a lokacin da aka qaddara.
death.i.sleepMinorDeath.title: Barci Karamar Mutuwa ce
death.i.sleepMinorDeath.label: Alkur'ani ya bayyana cewa Allah yana karbar rayuka a lokacin mutuwa da lokacin barci, yana mayar da wadanda ba a hukunta su ba har sai ajalinsu.
death.i.barzakhBarrier.title: Barzakh - Shamaki Har Zuwa Tashin Kiyama
death.i.barzakhBarrier.label: Alkur'ani ya bayyana cewa a bayan mamaci akwai barazak har ranar da za a tayar da su, a lokacin da aka busa kaho sannan su tashi daga wuraren hutawarsu.
death.i.martyrsAlive.title: Shahidai Suna Raye Ba Matattu ba
death.i.martyrsAlive.label: Alkur'ani ya yi umarni da kada a ce wadanda aka kashe a tafarkin Allah matattu ne, kuma suna raye a wurin Ubangijinsu, suna masu farin ciki da falalarSa.
death.i.momentOfDeath.title: Lokacin Mutuwa
death.i.momentOfDeath.label: Alqur'ani ya siffanta rai yana kaiwa ga kashin ƙugiya da kuma kallon sama a lokacin mutuwa, lokacin da ya yi latti don tuba.
death.i.returnToAllah.title: Ku koma ga Allah
death.i.returnToAllah.label: Alqurani yana karantar da cewa muminai sunce su na Allah ne kuma gareshi suke komawa, kuma zuwa gareshi suke komawa a ranar sakamako.
death.i.goodEndBadEnd.title: Kyakkyawar Ƙarshe Da Ƙarshe mara kyau
death.i.goodEndBadEnd.label: Alqur'ani ya bambanta mala'iku masu karɓar rayuka da kyautatawa da waɗanda suke karɓar rayukan azzalumai alhali kuwa suna cikin zunubi.
death.i.deathCannotBeEscaped.title: Ba za a iya tserewa mutuwa ba
death.i.deathCannotBeEscaped.label: Alqur'ani ya bayyana cewa mutuwa za ta riske ku a duk inda kuke, ko da a cikin benaye madaukaka, kuma gudu daga gare ta ba ta da amfani.
death.i.stateInGrave.title: Jihar a cikin kabari
death.i.stateInGrave.label: Alqur'ani ya siffanta mutanen Fir'auna suna shiga wuta safe da yamma a cikin Barzak gabanin Sa'a ta Lahira.
death.i.givingAccount.title: Bayarwa Bayan Mutuwa
death.i.givingAccount.label: Alqur’ani ya siffanta kafirai da suka yarda a lahira cewa sun mutu sau biyu kuma an rayar da su sau biyu, suna masu karvar laifukansu.
yusuf.i.yusufDream.title: Mafarkin Yusuf
yusuf.i.yusufDream.label: Alqur’ani ya ba da labarin Yusuf yana ganin taurari goma sha xaya da rana da wata suna sujada gare shi, wanda babansa Ya’qub ya fassara da alamar Annabci.
yusuf.i.brothersJealousy.title: Kishin Yan'uwa
yusuf.i.brothersJealousy.label: Alqur’ani ya yi bayanin yadda ‘yan’uwan Yusuf suka yi masa hassada saboda sun fi soyuwa a wajen babansu, kuma suka yi niyyar cire shi.
yusuf.i.thrownInWell.title: Jifa a cikin rijiya
yusuf.i.thrownInWell.label: Alqur’ani ya ce ‘yan’uwan Yusuf sun jefa shi a cikin rijiyar, daga baya aka same shi aka sayar da shi kan farashi mai rahusa ta hanyar ayarin wucewa.
yusuf.i.yusufInEgypt.title: Yusuf a dakin Al-Aziz
yusuf.i.yusufInEgypt.label: Alqur'ani ya bayyana cewa mutumin da ya sayi Yusufu a Masar ya kyautata masa, kuma Allah ya tabbatar da Yusuf ya kuma ba shi ilimi da hikima.
yusuf.i.seductionAccusation.title: Lalata da Zargi
yusuf.i.seductionAccusation.label: Al-Qur'ani ya kawo labarin cewa matar Al-Aziz ta nemi yin lalata da Yusuf, wanda ya ki, kuma makircinta ya fallasa a lokacin da aka yage rigarsa daga baya.
yusuf.i.banquetWomen.title: Bukin Mata
yusuf.i.banquetWomen.label: Alkur'ani ya bayyana yadda aka gayyaci matan da suka ji labarin lamarin, kuma da suka ga kyawun Yusuf, suka yanke hannayensu cikin mamaki.
yusuf.i.yusufPrefersPrison.title: Yusuf Ya Fi Son Gidan Yari
