yusuf.i.yusufPrefersPrison.label: Kur'ani ya rubuta cewa Yusuf yana addu'a ga Allah ya fifita kurkuku akan yin zunubi, kuma Allah ya amsa addu'arsa.
yusuf.i.dreamsInPrison.title: Mafarki a Kurkuku
yusuf.i.dreamsInPrison.label: Alqur’ani ya ba da labarin wasu sahabbai biyu a kurkuku suna raba mafarkinsu da Yusuf, wanda ya fassara su daidai da sanin Allah.
yusuf.i.kingDream.title: Mafarkin Sarki
yusuf.i.kingDream.label: Alqur'ani ya siffanta Sarkin Masar ganin shanu bakwai masu kiba da ramammu bakwai suka cinye, wanda Yusuf kadai ya fassara da shekaru masu yawa da fari.
yusuf.i.yusufExonerated.title: Karar Yusuf
yusuf.i.yusufExonerated.label: Alqur'ani ya bayyana cewa sarki ya kira Yusufu, wanda ya ki fita daga kurkuku har sai da aka tabbatar da cewa ba shi da laifi a bainar jama'a, wanda hakan ya kasance.
yusuf.i.brothersComeEgypt.title: 'Yan'uwa sun zo Masar
yusuf.i.brothersComeEgypt.label: Alqur’ani ya ba da labarin cewa ‘yan’uwan Yusuf sun zo Masar don neman abinci, ba tare da sun gane shi a matsayin wazirin da ya karbe su ba.
yusuf.i.reunificationProstration.title: Saduwa da Sujjada
yusuf.i.reunificationProstration.label: Alkur'ani ya ba da labarin cikar mafarkin Yusufu yana yaro lokacin da iyayensa da 'yan'uwansa suka yi masa sujada, yayin da ya sake haduwa da iyalansa.
yusuf.i.bestOfStories.title: Mafi kyawun Labarai
yusuf.i.bestOfStories.label: Alkur'ani ya bayyana labarin Yusuf a matsayin mafi kyawun kissoshi kuma ya bayyana cewa a cikin kissoshin annabawa akwai darasi ga masu hankali.
yusuf.i.yusufPrayer.title: Addu'ar Yusuf
yusuf.i.yusufPrayer.label: Kur'ani ya rubuta addu'ar Yusufu yana roƙon Allah ya bar shi ya mutu yana musulmi kuma ya shiga salihai, bayan an ba shi mulki da ilimi.
musa.i.musaCastInRiver.title: Musa Ya Zuba Ruwa
musa.i.musaCastInRiver.label: Alqur'ani ya ruwaito cewa Allah ya yi wahayi zuwa ga mahaifiyar Musa da ta sanya shi a cikin kogi, ya yi alkawarin dawo da shi, kuma ya mai da shi manzo.
musa.i.musaInPharaohsHouse.title: Musa a Gidan Fir’auna
musa.i.musaInPharaohsHouse.label: Alqur'ani ya ce mutanen Fir'auna sun tsince Musa daga kogi, sai matar Fir'auna ta ce kada su kashe shi domin ya amfana.
musa.i.musaFlees.title: Musa Ya Gudu Daga Masar
musa.i.musaFlees.label: Alqur’ani ya ba da labarin cewa Musa ya yi sanadin mutuwar wani mutum bisa kuskure, kuma ya tsere daga Masar bayan an gargade shi da wani makirci a kansa.
musa.i.musaInMadyan.title: Musa a Madyan - Aure
musa.i.musaInMadyan.label: Alqur’ani ya ce: Musa ya taimaki mata biyu shayar da garkunansu a Madyana, sannan ya auri xaya daga cikinsu bayan ya gama ajalinsa.
musa.i.burningBush.title: Bushe Mai Kona - Kira zuwa ga Annabta
musa.i.burningBush.label: Alkur'ani ya bayyana yadda Allah ya kira Musa daga cikin kwari mai tsarki a kurmin da yake kunar wuta ya nada shi a matsayin manzo zuwa ga Fir'auna.
musa.i.staffWhiteHand.title: Ma'aikata da Farin Hannu - Alamu
musa.i.staffWhiteHand.label: Alqur'ani ya rubuta cewa Allah ya ba wa Musa ayoyi guda biyu: sandarsa ta zama maciji, hannunsa yana fitowa fari.
musa.i.confrontingPharaoh.title: Fuskantar Fir'auna
musa.i.confrontingPharaoh.label: Alqur'ani ya ba da labarin Musa da Haruna sun je wurin Fir'auna don isar da sako da fafatawar da matsafa, wanda sandar Musa ta ci nasara.
musa.i.plaguesOnEgypt.title: Annoba a Masar
musa.i.plaguesOnEgypt.label: Alqur’ani yana cewa Allah ya kama mutanen Fir’auna da shekaru na fari da qarancin ‘ya’yan itace, kuma ya aiko da annoba a matsayin alamomi, har yanzu suna qaryatawa.
musa.i.partingOfSea.title: Rarraba Teku
musa.i.partingOfSea.label: Alqur'ani ya ruwaito cewa Allah ya umurci Musa ya bugi teku da sandarsa, sai ta rabu kamar busasshiyar hanya, ta ceci Banu Isra'ila yayin da sojojin Fir'auna suka nutse.
musa.i.goldenCalf.title: Maraƙin Zinare
musa.i.goldenCalf.label: Alqur'ani ya ba da labarin cewa Banu Isra'ila da Samiri ya batar da su, sun yi bautar maraqi na zinari a lokacin da Musa ba ya kan dutse, suka fusata Musa da Allah.
musa.i.torahAndTablets.title: Attaura da Allunan
musa.i.torahAndTablets.label: Alqur'ani yana cewa Allah ya rubuta wa Musa a cikin alluna shiriya da dalla-dalla ga dukkan komai, kuma ya baiwa Bani Isra'ila Attaura haske da shiriya.
musa.i.musaAtSinai.title: Musa a Dutsen Sinai
musa.i.musaAtSinai.label: Alkur'ani ya ce Allah ya sanya wa Musa dare arba'in a kan dutsen da ya karbi Attaura, alhali kuwa an karbo alkawari daga Bani Isra'ila.
musa.i.requestToSeeAllah.title: Neman ganin Allah
musa.i.requestToSeeAllah.label: Alqur'ani ya ba da labarin cewa Musa ya roƙi Allah ya nuna kansa, kuma da ɗaukakar Allah ta bayyana a kan dutsen sai ya ruɗe, Musa ya faɗi a sume.
musa.i.alKhidr.title: Musa da Al-Khidr
musa.i.alKhidr.label: Alqur’ani ya ba da labarin tafiyar Musa da wani mutum mai ilimi na musamman, wanda ya yi ayyuka uku da Musa ya tambaye su amma kowannensu yana da hikimar Ubangiji.
ibrahim.i.ibrahimQuestionsFather.title: Ibrahim Ya Tambayi Mahaifinsa
ibrahim.i.ibrahimQuestionsFather.label: Alqur’ani ya ba da labarin Ibrahim yana yi wa babansa magana da tausasawa, yana tambayarsa me ya sa yake bauta wa abin da ba ya ji, ba ya gani, ko amfanar da shi.
ibrahim.i.debatingStars.title: Muhawarar Taurari Da Jikin Sama
ibrahim.i.debatingStars.label: Alqur'ani ya siffanta Ibrahim yana nazarin taurari, da wata, da rana, kuma ya kafirta kowannensu a matsayin abin bautawa idan sun fadi, yana mai cewa ya koma ga mahalicci kadai.
ibrahim.i.ibrahimSmashesIdols.title: Ibrahim Ya Fasa Gumaka
ibrahim.i.ibrahimSmashesIdols.label: Alqur'ani ya ce: Ibrahim ya karya gumakan mutanensa sai manya-manya, sa'an nan ya kalubalanci su da su tambayi gumakansu wane ne ya aikata shi.
ibrahim.i.ibrahimCastIntoFire.title: Ibrahim Ya jefa a cikin Wuta
ibrahim.i.ibrahimCastIntoFire.label: Alqur'ani ya ruwaito cewa mutanen Ibrahim sun yanke shawarar kona shi a matsayin azabar fasasshiyar gumakansu, kuma sun bijirewa tafarkinsu.
ibrahim.i.fireBecomesCool.title: Wuta Ta Yi Sanyi
ibrahim.i.fireBecomesCool.label: Alqur’ani ya ce Allah ya yi umurni da a yi sanyi a kan wuta ga Ibrahim, kuma makircin da suka yi masa ya watse.
ibrahim.i.ibrahimMigrates.title: Ibrahim Yayi Hijira
ibrahim.i.ibrahimMigrates.label: Alqur’ani ya ce: “Ibrahim ya yi hijira, yana cewa yana tafiya zuwa ga Ubangijinsa, kuma Luɗu ya yi imani da shi, kuma suka yi tafiya tare.
ibrahim.i.ibrahimDuaForMecca.title: Salatin Ibrahim Ga Makkah da Iyalan gidansa
ibrahim.i.ibrahimDuaForMecca.label: Alqur'ani ya rubuta addu'ar ibrahim yana roqon Allah da ya sanya Makkah birnin aminci, ya azurta mutanenta da 'ya'yan itace, kuma ya sanya sallah a cikin zuriyarsa.
ibrahim.i.buildingKaaba.title: Gina Ka'aba da Isma'il
ibrahim.i.buildingKaaba.label: Alqur’ani ya bayyana cewa Ibrahim da Isma’il sun xaukaka harsashin xakin xaki mai alfarma, suna masu roqon Allah ya karva daga gare su, kuma ya sa su kasance masu tawali’u.
ibrahim.i.dreamSacrifice.title: Mafarkin Layya
ibrahim.i.dreamSacrifice.label: Alkur'ani ya ba da labarin cewa Ibrahim ya gani a mafarki yana yanka dansa, kuma a lokacin da suka mika wuya, sai Allah ya fanshi dan da hadaya mai girma.
ibrahim.i.ibrahimFriendOfAllah.title: Ibrahim Ya Kira Abokin Allah
ibrahim.i.ibrahimFriendOfAllah.label: Alkur'ani ya bayyana cewa Allah ya dauki Ibrahim a matsayin masoyi na kusa, sakamakon cikakken mika wuya da bin tafarkin tauhidi.
ibrahim.i.ibrahimPrayerForProgeny.title: Addu'ar Ibrahim Ga Zuriyarsa
ibrahim.i.ibrahimPrayerForProgeny.label: Alqur'ani ya rubuta cewa Ibrahim yana addu'a cewa a fito da wani manzo daga zuriyarsa don koyar da littafi da hikima da tsarkake mutane.
ibrahim.i.hanif.title: Hanif - Mai Tauhidi Tsarkaka
ibrahim.i.hanif.label: Alqur’ani ya siffanta Ibrahim a matsayin hanif, tsantsar tauhidi wanda ba mushriki ba, kuma ya kira muminai zuwa ga tafarkinsa.
cave.i.youthsSeekRefuge.title: Matasa Sun Nemi Mafaka A Cikin Kogon
cave.i.youthsSeekRefuge.label: Alqur'ani ya ruwaito cewa, samarin kogon sun gudu zuwa gare shi, kuma suka roki Allah da ya yi masa rahama da shiriya, kuma Ya rufe jinsu na tsawon shekaru.
cave.i.sleepOfCave.title: Barcin Kogon
cave.i.sleepOfCave.label: Alqur'ani ya ce rana ta ratsa su ba tare da ta shafe su ba, sun bayyana a farke amma sun yi barci, kuma suka zauna a cikin kogon tsawon shekaru dari uku da tara.
cave.i.debateOverNumber.title: Muhawara Kan Lambobin Su
cave.i.debateOverNumber.label: Alqur'ani ya ce mutane za su ce matasa uku ne, ko biyar, ko bakwai, kuma Allah ne kaɗai ya san adadinsu.
cave.i.theirAwakening.title: Wayyowar su
cave.i.theirAwakening.label: Alqur’ani ya ba da labarin yadda matasan suka farka ba tare da sanin tsawon lokacin da suka yi barci ba, suka aika da wani ya sayo abinci, kuma labarinsu ya zama ishara ga mutanen gari.
cave.i.twoGardenOwners.title: Muminai da Kafiri - Masu gidajen Aljanna guda biyu
cave.i.twoGardenOwners.label: Alqur'ani ya bambanta wani mutum wanda aka bai wa lambuna biyu, kuma ya yi girman kai, yana mai musun tashin qiyama, da abokinsa mumini, wanda ya yi masa gargaxi; gonar ta lalace.
cave.i.dhulQarnayn.title: Labarin Zul-Qarnain
cave.i.dhulQarnayn.label: Alqur'ani ya ba da labarin cewa Zul-Qarnaini ya yi tafiya zuwa iyakar duniya kuma ya gina wani shinge na ƙarfe da tagulla don hana Yajuju da Majuju.
cave.i.musaAndKhidr.title: Labarin Musa da Al-Khidr
cave.i.musaAndKhidr.label: Alkur'ani ya ba da labarin Musa yana neman wani mutum mai ilimi na musamman a mahadar tekuna biyu, wanda ya yi ayyuka uku kowanne dauke da hikimar Ubangiji da Musa ya kasa ganewa.
cave.i.doNotSayTomorrow.title: Kada Ku Ce 'Zan Yi Wannan Gobe'
cave.i.doNotSayTomorrow.label: Alkur'ani ya yi umarni da kada a ce ga wani abu 'Zan yi shi gobe' ba tare da kara 'in Allah Ya so ba', da ambaton Ubangijinka idan ka manta.
cave.i.tawakkulInCave.title: Tawakkul - dogara ga Allah gabaɗaya
cave.i.tawakkulInCave.label: Alkur'ani ya rubuta addu'ar samarin kogo suna rokon Allah da ya yi musu rahama da kuma daidaita al'amarinsu, suna masu tawakkali a gare shi.
cave.i.worldIsAdornment.title: Duniya Ado ce da Gudu
cave.i.worldIsAdornment.label: Alƙur'ãni ya kamanta rãyuwar dũniya da ruwan sama, mai sanya tsiri ya bushe, sa'an nan kuma ya bushe, kuma ayyukan ƙwarai su ne mafi alhẽri ga sakamako a wurin Ubangijinka.
cave.i.knowledgeWithAllah.title: Ilimin Allah ba shi da iyaka
cave.i.knowledgeWithAllah.label: Alkur'ani ya bayyana cewa da teku ta zama tawada ga kalmomin Allah, da ya kare kafin a fadi maganarsa, ko da kuwa an kara teku daidai.
cave.i.arroganceDestroyedByTime.title: Girman Kai Da Lokaci Ya Rusa shi
cave.i.arroganceDestroyedByTime.label: Alqur’ani ya yi bayanin yadda aka lalatar da amfanin gonakin mai girman kai a cikin dare, sai ya ce da shi bai yi shirka da kowa ba da Ubangijinsa.
modesty.i.menLowerGaze.title: Maza sun runtse ido
modesty.i.menLowerGaze.label: Alqurani ya umurci muminai maza da su runtse daga ganinsu, kuma su kiyaye farjinsu, yana cewa wannan shi ne mafi tsarki a gare su.
modesty.i.womenLowerGaze.title: Mata sun runtse ido
modesty.i.womenLowerGaze.label: Alqur'ani ya umurci mata muminai da su runtse daga ganinsu, kuma su kiyaye farjinta, a matsayin wani bangare na bukatu mafi girma.
modesty.i.womenDrawCovers.title: Mata Suna Zana Rubutun Su
modesty.i.womenDrawCovers.label: Alqur'ani ya umurci mata da su yi sutura a qirji, kuma matan Annabi da muminai mata su kusantar da tufafinsu a kusa da su.
modesty.i.jilbabFreeWomen.title: Tufafin Wajen Mata Muminai
modesty.i.jilbabFreeWomen.label: Alqur'ani ya umurci Annabi da ya ce wa muminai mata su zana tufarsu a kansu domin a gane su kada a cutar da su.
modesty.i.khimar.title: Khimar - Rufe kai
modesty.i.khimar.label: Alqur'ani ya umurci mata muminai da su yi sutura a kan qirjinsu, kuma kada su fito da qawarsu face abin da ya bayyana.
modesty.i.seekingPermission.title: Neman izini Kafin Shiga
modesty.i.seekingPermission.label: Alqur'ani ya umurci muminai da kada su shiga gidajen da ba nasu ba, ba tare da neman izini ba, da kuma gaishe da ma'abotanta.
modesty.i.modestWalking.title: Tafiya Mai Adalci
modesty.i.modestWalking.label: Alqur’ani ya umurci mata da kada su bugi qafafunsu domin jawo hankalinsu zuwa ga voyayyen qawarsu.
modesty.i.modestyInVoice.title: Girman kai a cikin murya
modesty.i.modestyInVoice.label: Alqur’ani ya umurci matan Annabi da kada su yi taushin magana don kada a jarabce masu zukata, sai dai su yi magana da kalmomin da suka dace.
modesty.i.screenAsPrivacy.title: Allon a matsayin Kariyar Sirri
modesty.i.screenAsPrivacy.label: Alqur'ani ya umurci muminai da su tambayi matan Annabi wani abu a bayan wani allo, domin wannan shi ne mafi tsarki ga dukkan bangarorin biyu.
modesty.i.notDisplayingAdornment.title: Ba Nuna Adon Ba
modesty.i.notDisplayingAdornment.label: Alqur'ani ya umurci mata muminai kada su yi ado da adonsu face ga wasu makusanta makusanta, kuma ya umurci matan Annabi kada su yi kwalliya.
modesty.i.garmentOfTaqwa.title: Tufafin Taqwa
modesty.i.garmentOfTaqwa.label: Alqur'ani yana cewa Allah ya sanya tufafin suturce tsiraici da ado, amma tufatar sanin Allah ita ce mafi alheri.
modesty.i.elderlyWomenPermission.title: Izinin Tsofaffi Mata
modesty.i.elderlyWomenPermission.label: Alqur'ani ya bayyana cewa tsofaffin mata da suka wuce shekarun haihuwa ba su da laifi idan suka ajiye tufarsu ba tare da sun yi ado ba.
modesty.i.modestyCombined.title: Girman Kai Tsaye
modesty.i.modestyCombined.label: Alqur'ani ya yi jawabi ga maza da mata da umarni da suka shafi kallo, tufafi, da mu'amala tare a matsayin cikakken tsari na kunya.
arrogance.i.doNotWalkProudly.title: Kada Ka Yi Tafiya A Duniya Da Alfahari
arrogance.i.doNotWalkProudly.label: Alqur’ani ya yi umurni da kada ku yi tafiya a bayan qasa da girman kai, domin ba za ku iya tsaga qasa ba, kuma ba za ku kai ga tsauni ba.
arrogance.i.arrogantNotEnterParadise.tit: Masu girman kai ba za su shiga Aljanna ba
arrogance.i.arrogantNotEnterParadise.lab: Alqur’ani ya ce, waxanda suka qaryata ayoyin Allah kuma suka yi girman kai ba za su shiga Aljanna ba, kuma za a ce su shiga qofofin Jahannama.
arrogance.i.iblisArrogance.title: Girman kan Iblis - Dokar Farko ta Kibr
arrogance.i.iblisArrogance.label: Alqur'ani ya ruwaito cewa Iblis ya qi yi wa Adam sujada, yana mai cewa shi ne mafi alheri saboda an halicce shi daga wuta, wanda ya sa ya fara nuna girman kai.
arrogance.i.pharaohArrogance.title: Girman Fir'auna
arrogance.i.pharaohArrogance.label: Alqur’ani ya bayyana cewa Fir’auna da rundunarsa sun yi girman kai ba tare da hakki ba, kuma Fir’auna ya yi kira da cewa shi ne Ubangiji mafi girma ga mutanensa.
arrogance.i.qaroonArrogance.title: Girman Qaroon
arrogance.i.qaroonArrogance.label: Alqur'ani ya ba da labarin cewa Qarun ya fita wa mutanensa adonsa yana alfahari da dukiyarsa, kuma qasa ta hadiye shi saboda haka.
arrogance.i.peopleOfAd.title: Mutanen Ad
arrogance.i.peopleOfAd.label: Alkur'ani ya ce mutanen Ad sun ce babu wanda ya fi su karfi, sai iska ta halaka su saboda girman kai.
arrogance.i.turningAwayInPride.title: Juyowa Cikin Alfahari
arrogance.i.turningAwayInPride.label: Alkur'ani ya siffanta wadanda suka ji ayoyin Allah kuma suka bijire suna masu girman kai da cewa suna da azaba mai radadi.
arrogance.i.turningFaceInContempt.title: Kar Ka Juya Fuskantar Mutane Masu Rana
arrogance.i.turningFaceInContempt.label: Alkur'ani ya yi umarni da kada ka karkatar da kuncinka daga mutane a kan wulakanci, kuma kada ka yi tafiya cikin rashin kunya, kuma ka kasance mai matsakaicin tafiya da runtse murya.
arrogance.i.allahDoesNotLoveArrogant.tit: Allah bã Ya son mãsu girman kai
arrogance.i.allahDoesNotLoveArrogant.lab: Alkur'ani ya bayyana karara cewa Allah ba Ya son masu girman kai da alfahari.
arrogance.i.walkingHumbly.title: Tafiya Cikin Kaskanci A Duniya
arrogance.i.walkingHumbly.label: Alqur'ani ya siffanta bayin mai rahama da cewa waxanda suke tafiya a bayan qasa cikin qanqan da kai.
arrogance.i.selfPraiseForbidden.title: An haramta Yabon Kai
arrogance.i.selfPraiseForbidden.label: Alkur'ani ya bayyana cewa kada a yi wa kanka tsarki, kamar yadda Allah ne Mafi sani ga wanda yake da gaskiya.
arrogance.i.servantsWalkHumbly.title: Bayin Mafi Rahamah Suna Tafiya Suna Tawassuli
arrogance.i.servantsWalkHumbly.label: Alqur’ani ya buxe siffanta bayin Allah na qwarai da sifofinsu na tafiya a qasa da qanqan da kai.
backbiting.i.backbitingFlesh.title: Cin Nama Idan aka kwatanta da Cin Nama
backbiting.i.backbitingFlesh.label: Alqur'ani yana tambaya ko akwai wanda zai so ya ci naman xan uwansa matacce, ya yi amfani da wannan a matsayin misalin gulma domin bayyana tsananinsa.
backbiting.i.avoidSuspicion.title: Kaucewa Yawan Zato
backbiting.i.avoidSuspicion.label: Alqur’ani ya umurci muminai da su nisanci zato da yawa, domin wasu zato zunubi ne, kuma kada su yi zagon qasa ko zage-zage.
backbiting.i.noSpying.title: Babu Leken asiri
backbiting.i.noSpying.label: Alqur'ani ya hana yin leken asiri ga juna, kuma ya yi umarni da kada a shiga cikin fagage ba tare da izini ba, tare da kare sirrin wasu.
backbiting.i.doNotMock.title: Kada Ku Yi Wa Juna Ba'a
backbiting.i.doNotMock.label: Alqur’ani ya hana muminai yin izgili da sauran mutane, domin waxanda ake izgili da su sun fi masu izgili da su.
backbiting.i.doNotCallBadNames.title: Kada Ku Kira Juna Mugun Suna
backbiting.i.doNotCallBadNames.label: Alqur'ani ya umurci muminai da kada su zagi juna da munanan laqabi bayan sun yi imani, suna kiransa da fasiqanci.
backbiting.i.slanderAgainstAisha.title: Zagi - Gargaɗi ga Muminai
backbiting.i.slanderAgainstAisha.label: Alqur’ani ya yi magana ga waxanda suka yi ta zage-zage a kan mace mumina, yana mai kiran sa da zunubi mai girma, da gargaxi cewa waxanda suke yada shi suna fuskantar azaba mai radadi.
backbiting.i.spreadingIndecency.title: Masu Yada Alfasha
backbiting.i.spreadingIndecency.label: Alqur'ani ya gargadi masu son ganin alfasha ta yadu a tsakanin muminai cewa suna da azaba mai radadi a duniya da lahira.
backbiting.i.speakRightly.title: Yi Magana daidai ko Yi shiru
backbiting.i.speakRightly.label: Alqur'ani ya umurci muminai da su ji tsoron Allah, kuma su yi magana na qwarai, domin Ya daidaita ayyukansu, kuma Ya gafarta musu zunubansu.
backbiting.i.accusingChasteWomen.title: Tuhumar Mata masu Kamun kai
backbiting.i.accusingChasteWomen.label: Alqur’ani ya yi umurni da bulala tamanin ga masu zagin mata masu kamun kai ba tare da shedu huxu ba, kuma ya bayyana cewa, waxanda ke zagin mata muminai tsarguwa, la’ananne ne.
backbiting.i.slandererTaleBearer.title: Mai Kazar-kazar Wanda Ya Tafi Akan Tatsuniya
backbiting.i.slandererTaleBearer.label: Alqur’ani ya la’anci waxanda ke yawo da zage-zage da zage-zage, da kashedi ga halaka ga duk mai izgili da kazafi.
backbiting.i.seekingPermissionPrivacy.la: Alqur'ani ya umurci muminai da kada su shiga gidajen wanin nasu, sai sun nemi izini kuma su yi sallama ga mazauna garin.
backbiting.i.forgiveAndOverlook.title: Gafara da Kaushe
backbiting.i.forgiveAndOverlook.label: Alqur'ani yana kwadaitar da masu hali da yin afuwa da gafala a maimakon su rama, kuma yana tambayar idan ba za su so Allah Ya gafarta musu ba.
